worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-1.english: * Looks like the backside of a polaroid.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-1.es: * Parece el reverso de una Polaroid.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-2.english: * A moon and stars are drawn all over it in green marker.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-2.es: * Hay una luna y estrellas dibujadas por todas partes con rotulador verde.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-4.english: * Yeah,[wait:5] I made it to remind me of what's most important.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-4.es: * Sí,[wait:5] lo hice para recordarme lo que más importa.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-5.english: * Holding onto hope that tomorrow will be a better day.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-5.es: * Aferrarme a la esperanza de que mañana será un día mejor.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-6.english: * And to never stop striving for my dreams.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-6.es: * Y nunca dejar de esforzarme por mis sueños.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-7.english: * It's just a little doodle,[wait:5] but...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-8.english: * Seeing those stars... [wait:5]\nReminds me that all my hope...[wait:5] All my work...
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-8.es: * Ver esas estrellas... [wait:5]\nMe recuerda que toda mi esperanza...[wait:5] Todo mi esfuerzo...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-9.english: * It's building up to something![wait:5]\n* Something real!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-11.english: * So never give up![wait:5]\n* Never stop hoping or dreaming.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-11.es: * ¡No te rindas![wait:5]\n* Nunca dejes de esperar ni soñar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-12.es: * Ese es mi lema,[wait:5] al menos.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-1.english: * In my professional opinion,[wait:5] this is clearly the lesser lamp.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-1.es: * En mi opinión profesional,[wait:5] esta es claramente la lámpara inferior.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-2.english: * Inside the drawer is a book.[wait:5]\n* The cover reads \"Mapping Out \nthe Night Sky.\"
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-2.es: * Dentro del cajón hay un libro.[wait:5]\n* La portada dice \"Cartografiando \nel Cielo Nocturno.\"

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-3.english: * It seems like it's been used\na lot,[wait:5] and a few of the pages \nseem to be missing.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-3.es: * Parece que se ha usado\nmucho,[wait:5] y parece que faltan \nalgunas páginas.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-bed-6.english: * It's pretty comfortable,[wait:5] you \nmay even go so far as to call \nit stellar.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-bed-6.es: * Es bastante cómoda,[wait:5] hasta \npodrías llegar a decir que es \nestelar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-2.english: * I mean...[wait:5] There's no reason to turn the light off yet,[wait:5] you know?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-2.es: * Quiero decir...[wait:5] No hay motivo para apagar la luz todavía,[wait:5] ¿sabes?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-3.english: * I'll turn it off myself when it's time to go to sleep.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-3.es: * La apagaré yo mismo cuando sea hora de dormir.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-1.english: * That's my hammock.[wait:5]\n* It's where I sleep at night.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-1.es: * Esa es mi hamaca.[wait:5]\n* Ahí es donde duermo por la noche.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-2.english: * Huh?\n* Why don't I just sleep on my bed?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-2.es: * ¿Eh?\n* ¿Por qué no duermo simplemente en la cama?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-5.english: * Seems fun to swing on,[wait:5] but it's slightly too high to reach.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-5.es: * Parece divertido columpiarse,[wait:5] pero está algo alta.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-2.english: * Don't worry, I've got loads of stuff to eat.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-2.es: * No te preocupes, tengo un montón de cosas para comer.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-3.english: * I can even cook something up for you,[wait:5] \nif you want.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-6.english: * You don't want to take anything.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-7.english: * The fridge is full of neatly organized COOKing ingredients.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-7.es: * El refrigerador está lleno de ingredientes de COCINA bien organizados.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-8.es: * Y también está enchufado,[wait:5] por cierto.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-9.english: * The fridge is filled to the \nbrim with dozens of different \nCOOKing ingredients.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-9.es: * El refrigerador está lleno hasta \nel borde con decenas de distintos \ningredientes de COCINA.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-10.english: * However,[wait:5] it isn't even plugged in...
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-10.es: * Sin embargo,[wait:5] ni siquiera está enchufado...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-pancakes-1.english: * .[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]You need to take care of this later.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-2.english: * It's small,[wait:5] but I find it quite cozy.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-2.es: * Es pequeño,[wait:5] pero me parece bastante acogedor.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-3.english: * It's nothing impressive,[wait:5] but it has the essentials.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-3.es: * No es nada impresionante,[wait:5] pero tiene lo esencial.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-4.english: * We have a kitchenette,[wait:5] a bed,[wait:5] a hammock and,[wait:5] most importantly,[wait:5] a lamp.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-4.es: * Tenemos una cocinita,[wait:5] una cama,[wait:5] una hamaca y,[wait:5] lo más importante,[wait:5] una lámpara.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-5.english: * You can take the bed.[wait:5]\n* I've been sleeping on that hammock for months.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-5.es: * Puedes quedarte con la cama.[wait:5]\n* Llevo meses durmiendo en esa hamaca.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-6.english: * Feel free to rest up,[wait:5] you probably need it after everything.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-6.es: * Descansa todo lo que quieras,[wait:5] seguramente lo necesitas después de todo.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-1.english: * What do you think?[wait:5]\n* Pretty nice place,[wait:5] \nisn't it?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-1.es: * ¿Qué te parece?[wait:5]\n* Es un lugar bastante bonito,[wait:5] \n¿no?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-2.english: * You don't get places like this in Snowdin.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-2.es: * No encuentras lugares así en Snowdin.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-4.english: * I've been living here for a while now,[wait:5] and I really love it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-4.es: * Llevo un tiempo viviendo aquí,[wait:5] y me encanta.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-5.english: * Who knew such a cramped space could make you feel so free?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-5.es: * ¿Quién diría que un espacio tan estrecho podría hacerte sentir tan libre?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-6.english: * You're probably wondering where I got the G to afford this.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-6.es: * Seguramente te preguntas de dónde saqué los G para pagar esto.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-10.english: * You see,[wait:5] this used to be a place my dad lived in for work.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-10.es: * Verás,[wait:5] este era un lugar donde mi papá vivía por trabajo.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-11.english: * Once he retired,[wait:5] he still had access to it,[wait:5] so he let me use it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-11.es: * Cuando se jubiló,[wait:5] todavía tenía acceso al lugar,[wait:5] así que me dejó usarlo.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-12.english: * That means I'm not the one paying for it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-12.es: * Eso significa que no soy yo quien paga esto.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-14.english: * Huh?[wait:5]\n* Are you worried about him paying for this?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-14.es: * ¿Eh?[wait:5]\n* ¿Te preocupa que él pague todo esto?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-15.english: * Don't worry, Sunny![wait:5]\n* He'll be fine.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-16.english: * Besides,[wait:5] once our restaurant becomes a big hit,[wait:5] we'll pay him back.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-16.es: * Además,[wait:5] cuando nuestro restaurante sea todo un éxito,[wait:5] se lo devolveremos.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-17.english: * I'm sure he'll be delighted.[wait:5]\n* Proud, even.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-17.es: * Seguro que estará encantado.[wait:5]\n* Incluso orgulloso.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-18.english: * Do you need something before you're comfortable sleeping?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-19.english: * Oh, I get it![wait:5]\n* You must be afraid of the dark!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-19.es: * ¡Ah, ya entiendo![wait:5]\n* ¡Debes tener miedo a la oscuridad!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-20.english: * Don't worry, Sunny.[wait:5] I get what that's like.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-20.es: * No te preocupes, Sunny.[wait:5] Sé lo que se siente.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-22.english: * Used to be! [wait:5]\n* Afraid of the dark![wait:5]\n* When I was a larva!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-22.es: * ¡Lo tenía! [wait:5]\n* ¡Miedo a la oscuridad![wait:5]\n* ¡Cuando era una larva!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-23.english: * And I'm not anymore![wait:5]\n* Because I'm a self-sufficient adult!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-23.es: * ¡Y ya no lo tengo![wait:5]\n* ¡Porque ya puedo valerme por mi cuenta!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-24.english: * ...[wait:5]Anyway, don't worry![wait:5]\n* There are night lights on the wall.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-24.es: * ...[wait:5]En fin, ¡no te preocupes![wait:5]\n* Hay luces nocturnas en la pared.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-26.english: * I am a very brave adult.[wait:5]\n* Who does not need to be patronized.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-26.es: * Soy muy valiente.[wait:5]\n* Y no necesito que me traten como a un niño.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You smell something delectable in the air.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Percibes un aroma delicioso en el aire.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Rise and shine,[wait:5] Sunny!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡Arriba y a brillar,[wait:5] Sunny!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Get up,[wait:5] I'm making breakfast!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡Levántate,[wait:5] estoy preparando el desayuno!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Here you go.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Aquí tienes.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Pancakes with some nice syrup,[wait:5] hot and ready to be eaten.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Panqueques con un buen jarabe,[wait:5] calientes y listos para comer.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Dig in,[wait:5] Sunny!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡A comer,[wait:5] Sunny!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Today's the day! I can hardly believe it!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡Hoy es el día! ¡Casi no puedo creerlo!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Can you believe it,[wait:5] Sunny?[wait:5] We're a real,[wait:5] ranked restaurant now!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¿Puedes creerlo,[wait:5] Sunny?[wait:5] ¡Ahora somos un restaurante de verdad,[wait:5] con clasificación!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * When I woke up and remembered,[wait:5] I couldn't contain my excitement!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Cuando desperté y lo recordé,[wait:5] ¡no pude contener la emoción!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * After everything that's happened[wait:2].[wait:2].[wait:2].
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Después de todo lo que ha pasado[wait:2].[wait:2].[wait:2].

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * So,[wait:5] what happened yesterday?[wait:5]\n* How well did we do?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Entonces,[wait:5] ¿qué pasó ayer?[wait:5]\n* ¿Qué tan bien nos fue?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh,[wait:5] have we ranked up yet?\n[wait:5]* Did the King show up?!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Ah,[wait:5] ¿ya subimos de rango?\n[wait:5]* ¡¿Apareció el Rey?!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * ...No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] what am I saying...[wait:5]\n* Obviously not.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ...No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] qué estoy diciendo...[wait:5]\n* Obviamente no.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * We still need quite a bit of [color:yellow]PRESTIGE[color:white] to make it to Rank 2.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Aún necesitamos bastante [color:yellow]PRESTIGIO[color:white] para llegar al Rango 2.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Huh?[wait:5] Is someone at the door?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¿Eh?[wait:5] ¿Hay alguien en la puerta?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * That's unusual.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Qué raro.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Who is it?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¿Quién es?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: [voice:courier][font:courier]* Who I am doesn't matter.[wait:5] I have a message for a[wait:5] Luna.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: [voice:courier][font:courier]* Quién soy no importa.[wait:5] Tengo un mensaje para una tal[wait:5] Luna.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh![wait:5]\n* That's me![wait:5]
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡Ah![wait:5]\n* ¡Soy yo![wait:5]

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Come on in.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Pasa.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Hmph.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Hmph.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I'm not here for chit-chat.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz sent me here and-[wait:15]
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * No vine a charlar.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz me mandó aquí y-[wait:15]

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Uh.[wait:5]\n* Why'd you do that?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Eh.[wait:5]\n* ¿Por qué hiciste eso?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * What.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Qué.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You just walked in and leaned against the wall.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Entraste y te apoyaste contra la pared sin más.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * And what's the wind magic for?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¿Y para qué es esa magia de viento?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Uh.[wait:5] I was just...[wait:5] Uh.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Eh.[wait:5] Yo solo estaba...[wait:5] Eh.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I mean.[wait:5]\n* Heh.[wait:5]\n* You wouldn't understand.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Quiero decir.[wait:5]\n* Je.[wait:5]\n* No lo entenderías.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I see...[wait:5]\n* So,[wait:5] what was the message?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Ya veo...[wait:5]\n* Entonces,[wait:5] ¿cuál era el mensaje?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh,[wait:5] right.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz is raising the price since you ranked up.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Ah,[wait:5] cierto.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz subió el precio porque ustedes subieron de nivel.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You may have noticed.[wait:5] It's up to 100 G per day now.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Quizá ya lo notaron.[wait:5] Ahora son 100 G al día.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * What?![wait:5]\n* Why?!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * ¡¿Qué?![wait:5]\n* ¡¿Por qué?!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Hmph.[wait:5]\n* Isn't it obvious?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Hmph.[wait:5]\n* ¿No es obvio?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * It's because of,[wait:5] uh...[wait:5]\n* Um.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Es por,[wait:5] eh...[wait:5]\n* Um.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Demand...[wait:5]\n* Market...[wait:5]\n* Uh...
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Demanda...[wait:5]\n* Mercado...[wait:5]\n* Eh...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I mean.[wait:5]\n* Finance is complicated.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * Quiero decir.[wait:5]\n* Las finanzas son complicadas.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I wouldn't expect you to understand.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.es: * No esperaría que ustedes lo entendieran.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-dj-1.english: * Another day,[wait:5] another party brought back to life by DJ Necrodance!

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-genie-3.english: * If you want coffee,[wait:5] you might want to return tomorrow.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-genie-4.english: * What?\n[wait:5]* You didn't know about the inn?

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-genie-9.english: * Draculatte quite likes the lad.\n[wait:5]* You'd get along well,[wait:5] I think.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-genie-9.es: * A Draculatte le cae muy bien el chico.\n[wait:5]* Creo que se llevarían bien,[wait:5] ¿sabes?

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-1.english: * This place reminds me of rot \nand death.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-1.es: * Este lugar me recuerda a podredumbre \ny muerte.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-3.english: * For the record,[wait:5] my lawyer has advised me to say this:
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-3.es: * Para que conste,[wait:5] mi abogado me aconsejó decir esto:

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-4.english: * \"I have never killed anyone.[wait:5]\n* Nor would I kill anyone.\"
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-4.es: * \"Nunca he matado a nadie.[wait:5]\n* Ni mataría a nadie.\"

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-5.english: * \"My interest in death,[wait:5] rot,[wait:5] and murder is purely hypothetical and intellectual.\"
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-5.es: * \"Mi interés por la muerte,[wait:5] la podredumbre,[wait:5] y el asesinato es puramente hipotético e intelectual.\"

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-fly-6.english: * But I think I would be really good at killing people if I did.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-4.english: * Why do I come here,[wait:5] then? Well,[wait:5] the truth is...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-11.es: * Tal vez usted simplemente tiene una de esas caras,[wait:5] ¿sabe?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-12.english: * Urgh![wait:5] If it isn't me,[wait:5] then it's my mother![wait:5] Meaning we sue anyway!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-12.es: * ¡Urgh![wait:5] Si no soy yo,[wait:5] ¡es mi madre![wait:5] ¡Así que demandamos igual!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-2.english: * I was challenging this lamp to a staring contest.\n[wait:5]* And I was winning,[wait:5] too!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-2.es: * Estaba retando a esta lámpara a un concurso de miradas.\n[wait:5]* ¡Y estaba ganando,[wait:5] además!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-3.english: * The staring at lamps club is going to be so ashamed of me...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-3.es: * El club de mirar lámparas fijamente se avergonzará tanto de mí...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-4.english: * Maybe I should look on the bright side.\n[wait:5]* And not blink this time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-4.es: * Quizá debería ver el lado luminoso.\n[wait:5]* Y no parpadear esta vez.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-5.english: * Oh,[wait:5] this guy looks like they have great taste. [wait:5]\n* Let me try...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-5.es: * Oh,[wait:5] esta persona parece tener muy buen gusto. [wait:5]\n* Déjame intentar...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-7.english: * DAMN IT ALL!!\n[wait:5]* YOU'VE RUINED EVERYTHING!!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-8.english: * Wh-[wait:5]Wha-?[wait:5]\n* I didn't...[wait:5] It wasn't my-

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-9.english: * Don't give me that![wait:5]\n* Because of you,[wait:5] I lost my staring contest.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-9.es: * ¡No me vengas con eso![wait:5]\n* Por tu culpa,[wait:5] perdí mi concurso de miradas.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-11.english: * YES,[wait:5] with a LAMP.\n[wait:5]* How else am I supposed to prove I have the strongest eye?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-11.es: * SÍ,[wait:5] con una LÁMPARA.\n[wait:5]* ¿Cómo se supone que pruebe que tengo el ojo más fuerte?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-12.english: * I'm going to tell the whole staring at lamps club about what you did here today!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-12.es: * ¡Le contaré a todo el club de mirar lámparas fijamente lo que hiciste hoy!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-13.english: * N-NO![wait:5]\n* I was just getting some renown there!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-13.es: * ¡N-NO![wait:5]\n* ¡Justo estaba empezando a ganar fama allí!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-15.english: * I run the soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the underground now!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-15.es: * ¡Ahora dirijo el futuro mejor restaurante del Subsuelo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-16.english: * I don't need to worry about what the lamp staring club thinks.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-16.es: * No tengo que preocuparme por lo que piense el club de mirar lámparas.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-17.english: * I'm headed for bigger and better.\n[wait:5]* AND brighter!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-17.es: * Voy hacia cosas más grandes y mejores.\n[wait:5]* ¡Y más BRILLANTES!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-18.english: * You wouldn't um...[wait:5]\n* Want to check out our restaurant,[wait:5] would you?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-21.english: * Maybe I should look on the bright side.\n[wait:5]* And not blink this time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-21.es: * Quizá debería ver el lado luminoso.\n[wait:5]* Y no parpadear esta vez.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-4.english: * To go or not to go...\n[wait:5]* Which would be more fun...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-4.es: * Ir o no ir...\n[wait:5]* Qué sería más divertido...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-6.english: * Well, [wait:5]if you're looking for fun,[wait:5] then might I interest you in
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-6.es: * Bueno,[wait:5] si buscas diversión,[wait:5] quizá pueda interesarte

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-7.english: * The soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the Underground!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-8.english: * Restaurant?[wait:5]\n* But I don't have a mouth.[wait:5]\n* I photosynthesize.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-8.es: * ¿Restaurante?[wait:5]\n* Pero no tengo boca.[wait:5]\n* Hago fotosíntesis.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Unless you serve the Sun,[wait:5] I'm afraid it's a no-go.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.es: * A menos que sirvan el Sol,[wait:5] me temo que no.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Sir,[wait:5] have I got news for you!
* We might not have the Sun,[wait:5] but we have something...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.es: * Quizá no tengamos el Sol,[wait:5] pero tenemos algo...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * We have Sunny here![wait:5]\n* That's close enough,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.es: * ¡Tenemos a Sunny aquí![wait:5]\n* Se parece bastante,[wait:5] ¿no?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Sunny,[wait:5] eh?[wait:5] \n* Do you emit electromagnetic radiation?
* Well then you're useless to me.[wait:5]\n* I'll find fun elsewhere!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.es: * Entonces no me sirves.[wait:5]\n* ¡Buscaré diversión en otra parte!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Come back when you emit UV rays,[wait:5] kid.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Vuelve cuando emitas rayos UV,[wait:5] joven.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Oh dear,[wait:5] it appears the park is closed.[wait:5] A tree fell or something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Vaya,[wait:5] parece que el parque está cerrado.[wait:5] Se cayó un árbol o algo así.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * A pity.[wait:5]\n* I was going to visit my grandmother.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Qué lástima.[wait:5]\n* Iba a visitar a mi abuela.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * But I suppose that will have to wait.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Pero supongo que tendrá que esperar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Or I could go home and not \nvisit her.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * O podría ir a casa y no \nvisitarla.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * And play Tree Games.\n[wait:5]* Games for Trees.\n[wait:5]* Tree Games.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Y jugar Juegos de Árbol.\n[wait:5]* Juegos para Árboles.\n[wait:5]* Juegos de Árbol.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * That sounds a lot more fun \nthan visiting my grandma.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.es: * Eso suena mucho más divertido \nque visitar a mi abuela.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-2.english: * The last one was scrambling towards the elevator like a chicken with its head cut off!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-2.es: * ¡El anterior corría hacia el ascensor como pollo sin cabeza!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-4.english: * This square used to be for engineers doing the hard work building the CORE.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-4.es: * Esta plaza era para los ingenieros que trabajaban duro construyendo el NÚCLEO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-5.english: * But now,[wait:5] it's being overtaken \nby young spuds like you.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-5.es: * Pero ahora,[wait:5] está siendo invadida \npor jovencitos como tú.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-6.english: * Every day I used to come home with calloused hands after setting up the pipes.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-6.es: * Cada día volvía a casa con las manos encallecidas tras instalar las tuberías.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-7.english: * There's just no drive in \ntoday's youth![wait:5]\n* Bah!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-7.es: * ¡La juventud de hoy no tiene \nningún empuje![wait:5]\n* ¡Bah!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-8.english: * I'd like to see this generation make something as great as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-8.es: * ¡Me gustaría ver a esta generación hacer algo tan grandioso como el NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-10.english: * Bah![wait:5] \n* Now all the youngins are congregating!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-10.es: * ¡Bah![wait:5] \n* ¡Ahora todos los jóvenes se están reuniendo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-12.english: * These kids...[wait:5] \n* Always running around like the world was made for you!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-12.es: * Estos jóvenes...[wait:5] \n* ¡Siempre corriendo como si el mundo fuera suyo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-13.english: * Bah! Stop being so lazy![wait:5] \n* No work ethic![wait:5] \n* No drive!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-14.english: * I bet you whippersnappers don't even know how lucky you are to have the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-14.es: * ¡Apuesto a que ni saben la suerte que tienen de contar con el NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-15.english: * Or how to operate a T-2850 Pipe Cleaning Royal Certified Precision Forklift!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-15.es: * ¡Ni cómo manejar una Carretilla de Precisión Real Certificada T-2850 para Limpiar Tuberías!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-16.english: * You youngins could never create something as beautiful and wonderous as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-16.es: * ¡Ustedes, jóvenes, jamás podrían crear algo tan bello y maravilloso como el NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-18.english: * We've got work ethic! [wait:5]\n * We've got drive!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-19.english: * We know how to operate a T-27...[wait:5] uh...[wait:5] Pipe Cleaning...[wait:5] Thing!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-19.es: * Sabemos manejar una T-27...[wait:5] eh...[wait:5] Limpiatuberías...[wait:5] ¡Cosa!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-20.english: * Maybe,[wait:5] we could end up making something that's never been done before!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-20.es: * ¡Quizá,[wait:5] acabemos creando algo que nunca se haya hecho!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-22.english: * Like the greatest restaurant in the underground!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-24.english: * What's a restaurant gonna do?![wait:5] \n* Feed people?[wait:5] Who work?[wait:5] \nOn what—[wait:5] The CORE!?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-24.es: * ¿¡Qué va a hacer un restaurante!?[wait:5] \n* ¿Dar de comer a gente?[wait:5] ¿Que trabaja?[wait:5] \n¿En qué—[wait:5] ¡El NÚCLEO!?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-25.english: * Could barely compare to the greatness of a Polybutylene Bend-45! Much less the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-25.es: * ¡Ni se compara con la grandeza de un Codo de Polibutileno-45! ¡Mucho menos con el NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-26.english: * Whatever you youngings try, \nit's still in its shadow!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-26.es: * Hagan lo que hagan ustedes, jóvenes, \n¡seguirá a la sombra de este lugar!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-30.english: * I'd like to see this generation make something as great as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-30.es: * ¡Me gustaría ver a esta generación hacer algo tan grandioso como el NÚCLEO!

* (IF YOU SEE \"For you to have a happy day. :D !!!\",[wait:5] PLEASE TELL THE ROYAL GUARD IMMEDIATELY.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.es: * La migración de los pequeñitos continúa con firmeza.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.english: * Millions will fall before they reach its terminus.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.es: * Millones caerán antes de alcanzar su destino.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.english: * [wait:5]...Before standing back up and continuing on.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.es: * Buena suerte,[wait:5] valientes peregrinos.[wait:5]\n* Buena suerte.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * [speed:1.2]Um![wait:5] We're not allowed in the CORE![wait:5] Authorised personnel only.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Eh![wait:5] ¡No podemos entrar al NÚCLEO![wait:5] Solo personal autorizado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * Besides,[wait:5] the CORE is really dangerous.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.es: * Además,[wait:5] el NÚCLEO es muy peligroso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * You wouldn't want to trip and fall in!
* You've already had one close call,[wait:5] no need for more!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.es: * Ya tuviste un susto,[wait:5] ¡no necesitas otro!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hiveenter.english: * Aren't they closed?[wait:5] \n* Maybe it's best if you[wait:5], uh,[wait:10] don't go in there.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hiveenter.es: * ¿No están cerrados?[wait:5] \n* Quizá sea mejor que,[wait:5] eh,[wait:10] no entres.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * Sorry!\n[wait:5]* The lower area is still under construction at the moment.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.es: * ¡Perdón!\n[wait:5]* La zona inferior sigue en construcción.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * We're installing some newfangled electrical wiring and doodads for a new business to run.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.es: * Estamos instalando cableado eléctrico moderno y cachivaches para un nuevo negocio.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * It's supposed to be something truly revolutionary.\n[wait:5]* Some crazy new surface tech.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.es: * Dicen que será algo revolucionario.\n[wait:5]* Una tecnología alocada de la superficie.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * I don't get the hype...[wait:5]\n* But I also live under a rock.[wait:5]\n* Literally.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.es: * No entiendo tanto entusiasmo...[wait:5]\n* Pero también vivo debajo de una roca.[wait:5]\n* Literalmente.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * Give us a few days and we'll be done with our work here,[wait:5] \nalright kid?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.es: * Danos unos días y terminaremos el trabajo aquí,[wait:5] \n¿vale, joven?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-1.english: * Sorry,[wait:5] buckaroo.\n* I can't let you through,[wait:5] no siree.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-1.es: * Lo siento,[wait:5] joven.\n* No puedo dejarte pasar,[wait:5] de ninguna manera.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-2.english: * The ittybitty migration is crossing this path.[wait:5] This happens only once a generation.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-2.es: * La migración de los pequeñitos está cruzando el camino.[wait:5] Solo ocurre una vez por generación.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-4.english: * How long is the migration going to take?[wait:5]\n* That's hard to gauge...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-4.es: * ¿Cuánto tardará la migración?[wait:5]\n* Es difícil calcularlo...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-5.english: * What?[wait:5] You want to pass?[wait:5]\n* Well,[wait:5] that sucks for you.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * This is outrageous!\n[wait:5]* OUTRAGEOUS,[wait:5] you hear me?
* Blocking the road for these...[wait:5] Weird little guys!\n[wait:5]* Absolutely absurd!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * ¡Bloquear la calle por estos...[wait:5] Tipitos raros!\n[wait:5]* ¡Totalmente absurdo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * How am I supposed to stand around in a single spot \nwithout moving now??
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * ¿¡Cómo se supone que me quede en un solo sitio \nsin moverme ahora!?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * The audacity of this guy![wait:5]\n* Getting in the way of everyone for these little blorbos.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * ¡Qué descaro tiene este tipo![wait:5]\n* Estorbando a todos por estos blorbitos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Although...[wait:5] They are pretty cute...[wait:5]\n* Argh![wait:5] Snap out of it!
* This is outrageous!\n[wait:5]* OUTRAGEOUS,[wait:5] you hear me?
* Blocking the road for these...[wait:5] Weird little guys!\n[wait:5]* Absolutely absurd!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * ¡Bloquear la calle por estos...[wait:5] Tipitos raros!\n[wait:5]* ¡Totalmente absurdo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * This wormular paradox hurts my brain and my ability to stand in one place.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * Esta paradoja vermicular me duele en el cerebro y en mi capacidad de quedarme quieto.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Blocking the alleyway...\n[wait:5]* And for what?
* I was really looking forward to getting mugged,[wait:5] you know.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.es: * Tenía muchas ganas de que me asaltaran,[wait:5] sabes.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Can you believe this hogwash?[wait:5]\n* Always with construction in \nthis goshdarn square...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.es: * ¿Puedes creer esta tontería?[wait:5]\n* Siempre hay obras en esta \nmaldita plaza...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Back in my day, we used magic to light our homes![wait:5] None of this tacky lamp nonsense!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.es: * ¡En mis tiempos usábamos magia para iluminar las casas![wait:5] ¡Nada de esas lámparas horteras!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Grumble grumble...\n[wait:5]* This square,[wait:5] I tell ya!
* What?[wait:5]\n* If I hate this place so much,[wait:5] why don't I leave?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.es: * ¿Qué?[wait:5]\n* Si odio tanto este lugar,[wait:5] ¿por qué no me voy?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Grumble grumble...\n[wait:5]* Grumble grumble,[wait:5] I say!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-1.english: * Sup dude.[wait:5]\n* Always nice to meet the new neighbours.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-1.es: * Qué tal, colega.[wait:5]\n* Siempre es bueno conocer a los nuevos vecinos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-2.english: * What's that expression for?\n[wait:5]* Is something wrong?[wait:5]\n* Was it something I said?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-3.english: * Alright,[wait:5] if you need anything just let me know,[wait:5] dude.\n[wait:5]* I live under these stairs.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-3.es: * Vale,[wait:5] si necesitas algo, avísame,[wait:5] colega.\n[wait:5]* Vivo debajo de estas escaleras.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-4.english: * I see you got a letter.[wait:5]\n* That's pretty cool,[wait:5] dude.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-4.es: * Veo que te llegó una carta.[wait:5]\n* Bastante genial,[wait:5] colega.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-5.english: * One time a mailman tried to shove a letter into my mouth.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-5.es: * Una vez un cartero intentó meterme una carta en la boca.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-6.english: * It was pretty tasty but that's besides the point.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-6.es: * Estaba bastante rica, pero eso no viene al caso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-7.english: * Dude,[wait:5] I saw a bunch of people fly out of your apartment.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-7.es: * Colega,[wait:5] vi a un montón de gente salir volando de tu apartamento.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-8.english: * Were you guys having a party in there or something?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-8.es: * ¿Estaban haciendo una fiesta o algo así?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-9.english: * Not judging,[wait:5] but...[wait:5] Maybe you could have invited me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-9.es: * Sin juzgar,[wait:5] pero...[wait:5] ¿Tal vez podrían haberme invitado?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-10.english: * I'm never invited to any neighbour parties...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-10.es: * Nunca me invitan a fiestas de vecinos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-11.english: * Dancing has gotten pretty popular in the Square it seems...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-11.es: * Parece que bailar se ha vuelto bastante popular en la Plaza...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-12.english: * They used to call me the dance king back in college.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-12.es: * En la universidad me llamaban el rey del baile.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-13.english: * I could tear up the dancefloor like nobody's business!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-13.es: * ¡Yo destrozaba la pista de baile como nadie!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-14.english: * All the ladies loved my dancing.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-14.es: * A todas las chicas les encantaba cómo bailaba.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-15.english: * I'm thinking of investing into the stock market.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-15.es: * Estoy pensando en invertir en la bolsa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-16.english: * By which I mean imagining a line going up.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-16.es: * Es decir, imaginar una línea subiendo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-1.english: * You'd best be careful around \nthe backstreets of the CORE Square,[wait:5] kiddo.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-1.es: * Ten cuidado por las \ncallejuelas de la Plaza del NÚCLEO,[wait:5] joven.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-2.english: * The square's got a squeaky\nclean veneer out here,[wait:5] but there's some real shady nooks.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-2.es: * La plaza parece impecable\npor aquí,[wait:5] pero hay rincones bastante turbios.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-3.english: * Keep an eye out,[wait:5] kiddo.\n[wait:5]* If you see something untoward,[wait:5] you should tell a royal guard.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-3.es: * Mantente alerta,[wait:5] joven.\n[wait:5]* Si ves algo sospechoso,[wait:5] avisa a un guardia real.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-4.english: * One time,[wait:5] a guy in a trenchcoat came up to me and tried to sell me something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-4.es: * Una vez,[wait:5] un tipo con gabardina se me acercó e intentó venderme algo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-5.english: * Told me it was the good stuff.\n[wait:5]* That I'd get completely hooked.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-5.es: * Dijo que era de la buena.\n[wait:5]* Que quedaría completamente enganchado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-6.english: * He was right![wait:5]\n* I haven't had a meal without mayonnaise since!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-6.es: * ¡Tenía razón![wait:5]\n* ¡Desde entonces no como nada sin mayonesa!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-7.english: * Would you be interested in our restaurant-

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-8.english: * Can it,[wait:5] kiddo.\n[wait:5]* I already got a dealer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-10.english: * You heard me.[wait:5]\n* Not interested in your business.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-10.es: * Lo oíste.[wait:5]\n* No me interesa tu negocio.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-12.english: * Anyway,[wait:5] yeah.[wait:5]\n* Be careful out there.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-12.es: * En fin,[wait:5] eso.[wait:5]\n* Ten cuidado por ahí.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * WE ARE STACK.\n[wait:5]* TOGETHER,[wait:5] WE ARE STRONG.\n[wait:5]* ANY CHALLENGE WE CAN OVERCOME!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.es: * SOMOS PILA.\n[wait:5]* JUNTOS,[wait:5] SOMOS FUERTES.\n[wait:5]* ¡SUPERAMOS CUALQUIER RETO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * THIS WILL BE OUR STRONGEST.[wait:5]\n* STAIRS.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.es: * ESTE SERÁ NUESTRO MÁS FUERTE.[wait:5]\n* ESCALERAS.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * IF WE FAIL,[wait:5] THE STACK WILL \nFALL,[wait:5] SO WE MUST THINK HARD \nABOUT PLAN.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.es: * SI FALLAMOS,[wait:5] LA PILA \nCAERÁ,[wait:5] ASÍ QUE DEBEMOS PENSAR \nMUCHO EN PLAN.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * HMMMM...[wait:5]\n* WE KNOW! [wait:5]\n* WHAT IF WE HIT IT?
* NO![wait:5]\n* BAD PLAN![wait:5]\n* BACK TO THINKING.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.english: * The ladies call me BIG HORNY.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.es: * Las chicas me llaman GRAN CACHONDO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.english: * They call me that because of my TOUGH and IMPRESSIVE HORN.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.es: * Me llaman así por mi CUERNO DURO e IMPRESIONANTE.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.english: * There is no other reason the ladies call me that.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.es: * No existe ninguna otra razón por la que las chicas me llamen así.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.english: * Honestly,[wait:5] it's really weird that it hasn't melted yet.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.es: * Sinceramente,[wait:5] es muy raro que todavía no se haya derretido.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.english: * Snowdin ice is something else,[wait:5] huh.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.es: * El hielo de Snowdin es otra cosa,[wait:5] ¿eh?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.english: * Oh...?[wait:5] That Chilly Chili you have...[wait:5] Would you give it to me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.es: * ¿Oh...?[wait:5] Ese Chile Helado que tienes...[wait:5] ¿Me lo darías?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.english: * Wow![wait:5] Thank you!\n[wait:5]* This will help me cool off for sure.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.es: * ¡Guau![wait:5] ¡Gracias!\n[wait:5]* Esto seguro que me ayudará a refrescarme.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.english: * Favor Complete! \n[color:yellow]Cool off or Blow off.
* Here,[wait:5] you can have this in exchange for helping me.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-1.es: * Toma,[wait:5] puedes quedarte con esto por ayudarme.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.english: * Oh...?[wait:5] That Freeze Fry you have...[wait:5] Would you give it to me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * ¿Oh...?[wait:5] Esa Frita Helada que tienes...[wait:5] ¿Me la darías?

* Here,[wait:5] you can have this in exchange for helping me.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * Toma,[wait:5] puedes quedarte con esto por ayudarme.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.english: * I'll keep the ice cream there to make sure I never forget.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * Dejaré el helado ahí para asegurarme de no olvidarlo nunca.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.english: * ...[wait:5]Yeah...\n[wait:5]* You know,[wait:5] I'm not sure what I was expecting.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * ...[wait:5]Sí...\n[wait:5]* Sabes,[wait:5] no sé muy bien qué esperaba.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.english: * But it was...[wait:5] You know.[wait:5]\n* Hot.
* Oh geez,[wait:5] now I'm worried that I'll get too hot and float up to the ceiling.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * Ay,[wait:5] ahora me preocupa calentarme demasiado y flotar hasta el techo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.english: * If only I had something cold to hold me down...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-balloon-2.es: * Si tan solo tuviera algo frío que me mantuviera abajo...

* Oh...?[wait:5] That Chilly Chili you have...[wait:5] Would you give it to me?
