worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Dos monstruos se encuentran y descubren que sus nombres coinciden...

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * It's straight out of a story!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * ¡Parece sacado de un cuento!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * And you seem to be perfectly equipped for COOKing,[wait:5] too.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Y pareces tener todo para COCINAR,[wait:5] también.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * It feels like the stars out on the surface are aligning.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Parece que las estrellas de la Superficie se están alineando.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * It's a sign![wait:5]\n* Destiny!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * ¡Es una señal![wait:5]\n* ¡Destino!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Wowzers,[wait:5] you must really believe in my dream...
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Vaya,[wait:5] de verdad debes creer en mi sueño...

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * If that's the case...[wait:5] I think you could end up being a great asset!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Si es así...[wait:5] ¡creo que podrías resultar de gran ayuda!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Wait...[wait:5] Your name...[wait:5]\n* Is it Sunny?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Espera...[wait:5] Tu nombre...[wait:5]\n* ¿Es Sunny?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Wow![wait:5]\n* I don't know how I remembered that!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * ¡Guau![wait:5]\n* ¡No sé cómo lo recordé!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * I usually forget names right away.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Normalmente olvido los nombres al instante.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Maybe that's a sign that our meeting was meant to be!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * ¡Quizá nuestro encuentro estaba destinado a ocurrir!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Oh,[wait:5] I'm Luna by the way.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Oh,[wait:5] por cierto, soy Luna.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * This restaurant...[wait:5][face:determination]\n* I can feel it![wait:5] Fate is on our side!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Este restaurante...[wait:5][face:determination]\n* ¡Lo siento![wait:5] ¡El destino está de nuestro lado!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * But that's enough of that.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * Pero basta de eso.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * We've got a restaurant to prepare,[wait:5] after all!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.es: * ¡Después de todo,[wait:5] tenemos un restaurante que preparar!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * Damn it-!\n[wait:5]* Why now,[wait:5] of all times?
* Come on,[wait:5] Luna.\n[wait:5]* Keep it together.
* Don't worry about me.[wait:3] I've got this all under control!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * No te preocupes por mí.[wait:3] ¡Está todo bajo control!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * I didn't need an extra pair of hands.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * No necesitaba otro par de manos.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * After all,[wait:3] I've already got that covered!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * Después de todo,[wait:3] ¡eso ya lo tengo cubierto!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * Get it?[wait:3] Because[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3] I have one more pair of arms than average?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * ¿Lo pillas?[wait:3] Porque[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3] ¿tengo un par de brazos más que el promedio?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * You got it![wait:5]\n* Pretty good joke,[wait:3] right?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * Pero basta de bromas,[wait:3] por ahora.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * We've got a whole day of work ahead of us!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.es: * ¡Tenemos todo un día de trabajo por delante!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Good morning, Sunny! [wait:2]\n* Did you sleep well?[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Buenos días, Sunny! [wait:2]\n* ¿Dormiste bien?[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Sorry for leaving you alone,[wait:5] I've been busy.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]Perdón por dejarte sin compañía,[wait:5] he estado con muchas cosas.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I've been working on The Eclipse for the past...[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]He estado trabajando en el Eclipse durante la última...[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [wait:5]Entire night.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [wait:5]Noche entera.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Don't worry about me, though![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Pero no te preocupes por mí![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I drank about 8,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 9,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 10[wait:2] cups of coffee.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]Bebí unas 8,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 9,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 10[wait:2] tazas de café.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Don't worry, I'm doing just fine. Great! Better than ever, eve-[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]No te preocupes, estoy muy bien. ¡Genial! Mejor que nunca, mejo-[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Wait,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] it was 11,[wait:5] sorry.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]Espera,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] fueron 11,[wait:5] perdón.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Anyway, I'm a natural night owl.[wait:5] It's in the name.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]En fin, soy criatura nocturna por naturaleza.[wait:5] Está en el nombre.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Oh, oh! I need to show you what I've been working on![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Oh, oh! ¡Tengo que enseñarte en qué he estado trabajando![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I just know you're gonna love it![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Sé que te va a encantar![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Come on, come on![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * [speed:1.2]¡Vamos, vamos![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Voilà![wait:5] \n* Isn't it just the best thing ever?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Voilà![wait:5] \n* ¿No es lo mejor del mundo?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * As it was,[wait:5] the restaurant looked really uninviting to customers.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Tal como estaba,[wait:5] el restaurante no resultaba nada acogedor para los clientes.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So,[wait:5] I decided to fix it up before we opened for the second day!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Así que,[wait:5] ¡decidí arreglarlo antes de que abriéramos el segundo día!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Isn't it great?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¿No quedó genial?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Oh,[wait:5] you haven't even seen the inside!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Oh,[wait:5] ni siquiera has visto el interior!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * No more holes.[wait:5] \n* No more leaky lava.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Sin agujeros.[wait:5] \n* Sin fugas de lava.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * And most of all,[wait:5] no more dull and dark grays!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Y sobre todo,[wait:5] ¡se acabaron los grises oscuros y aburridos!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Look,[wait:5] I even used the lava from the bucket to make that lamp!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Mira,[wait:5] ¡hasta usé la lava del cubo para hacer esa lámpara!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Gives the place a much more inviting vibe.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Le da al lugar un ambiente mucho más acogedor.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * And that's not even the best part!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Y esa ni siquiera es la mejor parte!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * I've gone ahead and sent out an application...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Ya envié una solicitud...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * To the Royal Underground Association of Eaters!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡A la Asociación Real Subterránea de Comensales!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * They'll get us certified as a restaurant!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Nos certificarán como restaurante!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * The letter should arrive sometime today!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡La carta debería llegar hoy en algún momento!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Huh?[wait:5] \n * A letter for me?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¿Eh?[wait:5] \n * ¿Una carta para mí?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Oh![wait:5] This has got to be it![wait:5] \n* It's from the RUGAE!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Oh![wait:5] ¡Tiene que ser esto![wait:5] \n* ¡Es de la ARSC!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Let's see this...[wait:5] \n * \"We have reviewed your application...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Veamos...[wait:5] \n * \"Hemos revisado su solicitud...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Yada yada...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Bla bla bla...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * It always takes a bit of waffle for them to get to the point... [react:1]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Siempre dan unas cuantas vueltas antes de ir al grano... [react:1]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Here it is!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Aquí está!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"We would like to congratulate The Eclipse...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * \"Nos gustaría felicitar al Eclipse...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"...for being recognized by the RUGAE...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * \"...por ser reconocido por la ARSC...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"...and officially grant it the rank of-\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * \"...y concederle oficialmente el rango de-\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Incredible![wait:5] \n* We're officially a ranked restaurant!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Increíble![wait:5] \n* ¡Oficialmente somos un restaurante con rango!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * It's the,[wait:5] uh[wait:8][speed:0.5]...[speed:1][wait:5] \n* Lowest rank,[wait:15] but[wait:10] look on the bright side.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Es el,[wait:5] eh[wait:8][speed:0.5]...[speed:1][wait:5] \n* Rango más bajo,[wait:15] pero[wait:10] mira el lado bueno.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * We're only four ranks away from the highest possible one!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Estamos a solo cuatro rangos del más alto posible!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * There's yet to be a 5-star restaurant in the entire Underground.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Todavía no existe un restaurante de 5 estrellas en todo el Subsuelo.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So if we get to 5 stars,[wait:5] then there's no doubt about it!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Así que si llegamos a 5 estrellas,[wait:5] ¡no habrá duda!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * We'll be the greatest restaurant...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Seremos el mejor restaurante...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * That the Underground has ever seen!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡Que el Subsuelo haya visto jamás!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * All we need to raise our rank is more PRESTIGE.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Solo necesitamos más PRESTIGIO para subir de rango.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So we just need to keep making sure everyone-
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Así que solo debemos asegurarnos de que todos-

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * - and I mean everyone-
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * - y digo todos-

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * - who comes through these doors leaves satisfied!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * - ¡que entren por estas puertas salgan satisfechos!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Well,[wait:5] what are we waiting for?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * Bueno,[wait:5] ¿qué estamos esperando?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * The Eclipse won't rank up by itself!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡El Eclipse no subirá de rango por sí solo!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Let's get COOKing!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.es: * ¡A COCINAr!

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-2.english: * But there's no reason to call.[wait:5]\n* She's right over there,[wait:5]\nafter all.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-2.es: * Pero no hay razón para llamar.[wait:5]\n* Después de todo,[wait:5]\nestá justo ahí.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-4.english: * But you shouldn't.\n[wait:5]* You really shouldn't.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-4.es: * Pero no deberías.\n[wait:5]* De verdad no deberías.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-5.english: * You tried to use your phone,

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-6.english: * But it seems like it got wet when you fell in the river and broke.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-6.es: * Pero parece que se mojó cuando caíste al río y se rompió.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-7.english: * The phone is now mostly made \nof river water.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-7.es: * Ahora el teléfono está hecho casi \ntodo de agua del río.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-8.english: * You suppose it was never a landline,[wait:5] anyway.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-8.es: * De todos modos,[wait:5] nunca fue un teléfono fijo.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-9.english: * You mourn the loss of your digital pet for a moment.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-9.es: * Lamentas la pérdida de tu mascota digital por un momento.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-10.english: * This is the first time you've missed feeding it in years.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-10.es: * Es la primera vez en años que olvidas darle de comer.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-11.english: * After a day in Hotland,[wait:5] you check to see if your phone\nhas dried.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-11.es: * Tras un día en Hotland,[wait:5] compruebas si el teléfono\nya se secó.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-13.english: * Your wet phone is now boiling.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-13.es: * Tu teléfono mojado ahora está hirviendo.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-14.english: * Does this make it a hotline?
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-14.es: * ¿Eso lo convierte en una línea caliente?

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-15.english: * You check to see if your phone is working yet.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-15.es: * Compruebas si el teléfono ya funciona.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-17.english: * You hope people don't think you're giving them the cold shoulder.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-17.es: * Esperas que la gente no crea que les estás dando la espalda fría.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-18.es: * Por fin,[wait:5] después de todo este tiempo,

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-19.english: * You can finally use the cell phone.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-19.es: * Por fin puedes usar el teléfono.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-20.english: * You hold it steadily in your hand,[wait:5] bringing your finger to the buttons.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-20.es: * Lo sostienes con firmeza,[wait:5] acercando el dedo a los botones.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-22.es: * No sabes el número de nadie.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-23.english: * Without any number to call,[wait:5] it's useless.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-23.es: * Sin ningún número al que llamar,[wait:5] es inútil.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-24.english: * If you're seeing this, I fucked up bigtime.\n* Send a bug report or something.
worldcutscene-general-text-cell-24.es: * Si estás viendo esto, la cagué a lo grande.\n* Manda un informe de error o algo.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-7.english: * Oh gee,[wait:5] oh biscuits,[wait:5] what do we do now?\n[wait:5]* If Mawzz finds out we-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-7.es: * Ay,[wait:5] ay madre,[wait:5] ¿qué hacemos ahora?\n[wait:5]* Si Mawzz descubre que nosotros-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-8.english: * Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] well.[wait:5]\n* If it isn't my two favourite little fish.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-8.es: * Vaya,[wait:5] vaya,[wait:5] vaya.[wait:5]\n* Si no son mis dos pececillos favoritos.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-10.english: * Listen...[wait:5] I know we weren't able to pay you today but-
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-10.es: * Escucha...[wait:5] Sé que no pudimos pagarte hoy, pero-

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-11.english: * Just give us another chance,[wait:5] another day,[wait:5] we'll pay you back then!
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-11.es: * ¡Solo danos otra oportunidad,[wait:5] otro día,[wait:5] y te pagaremos entonces!

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-12.english: * I promise,[wait:5] I promise I-[wait:5] We can do it![wait:5] Just please-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-12.es: * Lo prometo,[wait:5] prometo que-[wait:5] ¡Podemos hacerlo![wait:5] Solo por favor-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-13.english: * No need for empty promises fuzz.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-13.es: * No hacen falta promesas vacías, peluche.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-14.english: * After all,[wait:5] your signature is a lot more binding than your word.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-14.es: * Después de todo,[wait:5] tu firma obliga mucho más que tu palabra.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-15.english: * You knew what you were signing up for.[wait:5] It was all on the page.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-15.es: * Sabías en lo que te metías.[wait:5] Estaba todo en la página.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-16.english: * We'd both prefer if this venture kept rolling on for a little bit longer,
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-16.es: * Ambos preferiríamos que esta empresa siguiera rodando un poco más,

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-18.english: * So I reckon it's about time we start talking[wait:5] [speed:0.5]collateral.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-18.es: * Así que creo que ya es hora de hablar de[wait:5] [speed:0.5]garantías.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-20.english: * I-[wait:5]I'll let you take anything,[wait:5] whatever is necessary to keep the-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-20.es: * T-[wait:5]Te dejaré llevarte cualquier cosa,[wait:5] lo que haga falta para mantener el-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-21.english: * Zip it,[wait:5] fuzz.[wait:5] This ain't about you anymore.\n[wait:5]* You're worthless to me.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-21.es: * Cállate,[wait:5] peluche.[wait:5] Esto ya no va de ti.\n[wait:5]* No vales nada para mí.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-25.es: * ...Dime,[wait:5] te encanta ayudar a la gente,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-26.english: * Wanna help your little pal over there?
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-26.es: * ¿Quieres ayudar a tu amiguito de ahí?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-27.english: * You wouldn't mind paying that collateral,[wait:5] wouldja?
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-27.es: * No te importaría pagar esa garantía,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-28.english: * Sunny?[wait:5]\n* You would do that for me?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-29.english: * You'd really do that,[wait:5] huh?[wait:5]\n* Now ain't that sweet.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-29.es: * De verdad harías eso,[wait:5] ¿eh?[wait:5]\n* Qué dulce.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-2.english: * Whale,[wait:5] whale,[wait:5] whale.[wait:10]\n* Look who it is.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-2.es: * Ballena,[wait:5] ballena,[wait:5] ballena.[wait:10]\n* Mira quién está aquí.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-3.english: * That eager to talk to your old pal Whaley again?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-3.es: * ¿Tantas ganas de volver a hablar con tu viejo amigo Whaley?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-5.english: [noskip]* Whale,[wait:5] friend,[wait:5] you seem to be skipping through what I'm saying.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-5.es: [noskip]* Ballena,[wait:5] amigo,[wait:5] parece que estás saltándote lo que digo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-6.english: [noskip]* That's not a very nice thing to do,[wait:5] now is it?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-7.english: [noskip]* Especially when I'm being so generous,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-7.es: [noskip]* Sobre todo cuando estoy siendo tan generoso,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-8.english: [noskip]* As to allow you to go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-8.es: [noskip]* Como para dejarte volver adonde se supone que debes estar.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-10.english: [noskip]* And go back to where you just were.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-11.english: * But I'm afraid it'll be a while until we can have a real conversation.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-11.es: * Pero me temo que pasará un tiempo antes de que tengamos una conversación de verdad.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-14.english: * Whale,[wait:5] whale,[wait:5] whale.[wait:10]\n* Look who it is.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-14.es: * Ballena,[wait:5] ballena,[wait:5] ballena.[wait:10]\n* Mira quién está aquí.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-15.english: * You're not supposed to be here,[wait:5] friend.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-15.es: * No se supone que debas estar aquí,[wait:5] amigo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-16.english: * But who cares about that here,[wait:5] right,[wait:5] friend?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-16.es: * Pero a quién le importa eso aquí,[wait:5] ¿verdad,[wait:5] amigo?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-17.english: * Isn't it so much more fun to \nnot take this seriously?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-17.es: * ¿No es mucho más divertido \nno tomarse esto en serio?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-18.english: * That whole thing you left behind...

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-19.english: * Isn't it tacky?\n[wait:5]* Isn't it comical how hard it's trying?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-19.es: * ¿No es hortera?\n[wait:5]* ¿No es cómico lo mucho que intenta esforzarse?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-20.english: * Yup,[wait:5] yup,[wait:5] I'd say it's quite \nfun to...[wait:5]\n* Whale on it a bit,[wait:5] no?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-20.es: * Sí,[wait:5] sí,[wait:5] diría que es bastante \ndivertido...[wait:5]\n* Ballenear un poco con ello,[wait:5] ¿no?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-21.english: * Still,[wait:5] it's really risky,[wait:5] what you're doin'.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-21.es: * Aun así,[wait:5] es bastante arriesgado,[wait:5] lo que estás haciendo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-22.english: [noskip]* Whale,[wait:5] friend,[wait:5] you seem to be skipping through what I'm saying.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-22.es: [noskip]* Ballena,[wait:5] amigo,[wait:5] parece que estás saltándote lo que digo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-23.english: [noskip]* That's not a very nice thing to do,[wait:5] now is it?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-24.english: [noskip]* Especially when I'm being so generous,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-24.es: [noskip]* Sobre todo cuando estoy siendo tan generoso,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-25.english: [noskip]* As to allow you to go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-25.es: [noskip]* Como para dejarte volver adonde se supone que debes estar.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-27.english: [noskip]* And go back to where you just were.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-28.english: * You could make everything crash and burn before it's supposed to!
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-28.es: * ¡Podrías hacer que todo se bloquee y arda antes de tiempo!

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-29.english: * And we're still having some fun here,[wait:5] aren't we?[wait:10]
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-29.es: * Y aún nos estamos divirtiendo aquí,[wait:5] ¿verdad?[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-30.english: * So why don't you do your friend Whaley a favor,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-30.es: * Así que hazle un favor a tu amigo Whaley,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-31.english: * And go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-31.es: * Y vuelve adonde se supone que debes estar.

worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.es: [voice:ut]* Las buenas personas nunca son egoístas.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* Las buenas personas ponen a los demás primero.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.english: [voice:ut]* Good people would do anything for others.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.es: [voice:ut]* Las buenas personas harían cualquier cosa por los demás.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* La gente mala les quita cosas a otros.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* La gente mala hace daño a otros.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.english: [voice:ut]* Bad people only think of themselves.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.es: [voice:ut]* Las malas personas solo piensan en sí mismas.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-str_good-eviltext-.english: Are you a good person, Sunny?

worldcutscene-general-str_bad-eviltext-1.english: Are you a bad person, Sunny?

worldcutscene-home-text-watersausage-2.english: * A water sausage.[wait:5]\n* Good for making hot dogs.
worldcutscene-home-text-watersausage-2.es: * Una salchicha de agua.[wait:5]\n* Buena para hacer perritos calientes.

worldcutscene-home-text-shoes-2.english: * A box of kids' shoes in a disparity of sizes.
worldcutscene-home-text-shoes-2.es: * Una caja de zapatos infantiles de muchos tamaños distintos.

worldcutscene-home-text-drawer1-2.english: * There are flower seeds and\nbroken crayons in the drawer.
worldcutscene-home-text-drawer1-2.es: * Hay semillas de flores y\nceras rotas en el cajón.

worldcutscene-home-text-flower-2.english: * A flower.[wait:5]\n* Toriel always makes sure to water it.
worldcutscene-home-text-flower-2.es: * Una flor.[wait:5]\n* Toriel siempre se asegura de regarla.

worldcutscene-home-text-bookshelf-2.english: * Many books are resting on the shelf.
worldcutscene-home-text-bookshelf-2.es: * Muchos libros descansan en la estantería.

worldcutscene-home-text-bookshelf-3.es: * Ya has leído la mayoría\nde ellos.

worldcutscene-home-text-tools-2.english: * The tools have been filed down.

worldcutscene-home-text-tools-3.english: * You feel somewhat patronized by this.
worldcutscene-home-text-tools-3.es: * Sientes que te están tratando como a una criatura.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed-1.english: * It was nice while it lasted.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed-2.english: * You've slept quite enough,[wait:5]\ntime to get on with your\nday.
worldcutscene-home-text-bed-2.es: * Ya has dormido bastante,[wait:5]\nes hora de seguir con tu\ndía.

worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-1.english: * You'll miss eating this well,[wait:5]\nbut it's for the best.
worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-1.es: * Echarás de menos comer así de bien,[wait:5]\npero es lo mejor.

worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-3.english: * You should talk to Toriel\nfirst,[wait:5] though.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-1.english: * You hold your hands out towards \nthe heat despite yourself.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-1.es: * Sin darte cuenta, acercas las manos \nal calor.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-2.english: * You chide yourself for getting \nso comfortable here.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-2.es: * Te reprendes por haberte sentido \ntan a gusto aquí.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-3.english: * You should have known this was \ntoo good to be true.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-3.es: * Deberías haber sabido que esto era \ndemasiado bueno para ser verdad.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-4.english: * The fireplace is so pleasant \nand warm.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-4.es: * La chimenea es muy agradable \ny cálida.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-5.english: * You can't remember the last \ntime you felt so comfortable.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-5.es: * No recuerdas la última \nvez que te sentiste tan a gusto.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-1.es: * El sillón de lectura de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-2.english: * You enjoyed reading on it,[wait:5] even\nif it was too big for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-2.es: * Te gustaba leer en él,[wait:5] aunque\nera demasiado grande para ti.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-3.es: * El sillón de lectura de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-4.english: * You enjoyed reading on it,[wait:5] even\nif it was too big for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-4.es: * Te gustaba leer en él,[wait:5] aunque\nera demasiado grande para ti.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-5.english: * Ah,[wait:5] you are awake! \n[wait:5]* I have prepared breakfast, [wait:5]my child.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-5.es: * ¡Ah,[wait:5] has despertado! \n[wait:5]* He preparado el desayuno,[wait:5] mi criatura.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-6.english: * I think you will really enjoy it.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-6.es: * Creo que te va a encantar.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-7.english: * After all,[wait:5] the eggs are \nSunny-side up!
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-7.es: * Después de todo,[wait:5] ¡los huevos están \na la Sunny!

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-9.es: * Adelante,[wait:5] antes de que se enfríen.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-10.english: * I have a surprise for you when you finish.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-10.es: * Tengo una sorpresa para ti cuando termines.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-11.english: * I had a delightful time on our excursion yesterday.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-11.es: * Me lo pasé de maravilla en nuestra excursión de ayer.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-12.english: * Even if we were unable to catch any bugs.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-12.es: * Aunque no conseguimos atrapar ningún insecto.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-13.english: * Also,[wait:5] about the net...\n[wait:5]* It is alright.[wait:5]\n* It was quite old.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-13.es: * Además,[wait:5] sobre la red...\n[wait:5]* No pasa nada.[wait:5]\n* Ya era bastante vieja.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-14.english: * There is no need to be upset about breaking it.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-14.es: * No hace falta que te sientas mal por haberla roto.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-15.english: * What matters is that the two of us had fun,[wait:5] did we not?
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-15.es: * Lo importante es que nos divertimos,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-16.english: * Taking care of a child like you...
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-16.es: * Cuidar de una criatura como tú...

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-17.english: * It does much to warm this old woman's heart.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-17.es: * Reconforta mucho el corazón de esta anciana.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-18.english: * Why,[wait:5] it is like being warmed by the very Sun!
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-18.es: * Vaya,[wait:5] ¡es como recibir el calor del mismísimo Sol!

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-19.english: * Ah,[wait:5] have you finished your eggs?[wait:10] My,[wait:5] you must have been hungry.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-19.es: * Ah,[wait:5] ¿ya terminaste los huevos?[wait:10] Vaya,[wait:5] debías tener mucha hambre.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-20.english: * Either that or you are very excited for the surprise.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-20.es: * O eso, o tienes muchas ganas de ver la sorpresa.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-1.english: * I know how much you like my Butterscotch-Cinnamon pies.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-1.es: * Sé cuánto te gustan mis tartas de Caramelo y Canela.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-2.english: * So,[wait:5] I have decided to do something I have always wanted to do.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-2.es: * Así que,[wait:5] he decidido hacer algo que siempre he querido hacer.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-3.english: * I shall teach you how to make one yourself,[wait:5] following my own recipe.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-3.es: * Te enseñaré a preparar una,[wait:5] siguiendo mi propia receta.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-4.english: * But first,[wait:5] I have yet another surprise for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-4.es: * Pero antes,[wait:5] tengo otra sorpresa para ti.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-7.english: * Your very own apron,[wait:5] sewn with love.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-7.es: * Tu propio delantal,[wait:5] cosido con amor.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-8.english: * This is why I asked to take your measurements a few days ago.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-8.es: * Por eso te pedí las medidas hace unos días.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-9.english: * Maybe once I teach you how to COOK,[wait:5] I can teach you crochet,[wait:5] as well.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-9.es: * Quizá cuando te enseñe a COCINAr,[wait:5] también pueda enseñarte ganchillo,[wait:5] ¿sabes?

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-10.english: * I think you would really enjoy it.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-11.english: * Now,[wait:5] let us begin,[wait:5] shall we?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-1.english: * That was some wonderful COOKing,[wait:5] my child. [wait:5]\n* I am proud of you.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-1.es: * Ha sido una COCINA maravillosa,[wait:5] mi criatura. [wait:5]\n* Estoy orgullosa de ti.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-2.english: * The pie will still take a few minutes to cool off.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-2.es: * La tarta aún necesita unos minutos para enfriarse.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-3.english: * How about we sit by the fireplace and read together?
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-3.es: * ¿Qué tal si nos sentamos junto a la chimenea y leemos juntos?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-4.english: * I have a book about snails that I think you might-
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-4.es: * Tengo un libro sobre caracoles que creo que podría-

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-5.english: * My apologies,[wait:5] Sunny. [wait:5]\n* Give me a moment.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-5.es: * Mis disculpas,[wait:5] Sunny. [wait:5]\n* Dame un momento.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-6.english: * Greetings,[wait:5] this is Toriel,[wait:5] how may I-

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-8.english: * Well,[wait:5] I will be over to resolve the situation in just a moment.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-8.es: * Bien,[wait:5] iré a resolver la situación enseguida.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-9.english: * I am sorry,[wait:5] young one,[wait:5] there is something I must attend to.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-9.es: * Lo siento,[wait:5] joven,[wait:5] hay algo que debo atender.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-10.english: * Stay here and be good,[wait:5] won't you?
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-10.es: * Quédate aquí y pórtate bien,[wait:5] ¿de acuerdo?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-11.english: * I am sure you can handle it.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-12.english: * I will return soon,[wait:5] so do not wander.[wait:5] It is dangerous out there.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-12.es: * Volveré pronto,[wait:5] así que no te alejes.[wait:5] Es peligroso ahí fuera.

worldcutscene-home-text-closet-2.english: * Unfortunately,[wait:5] you can't take\nthem with you.[wait:5]\n* You shouldn't.
worldcutscene-home-text-closet-2.es: * Por desgracia,[wait:5] no puedes\nllevártela contigo.[wait:5]\n* No deberías.

worldcutscene-home-text-closet-3.english: * This is where all the clothes\nToriel gave you are.
worldcutscene-home-text-closet-3.es: * Aquí está toda la ropa\nque Toriel te dio.

worldcutscene-home-text-photo-1.english: * You feel like this photo frame\nwill stay empty for a long time.
worldcutscene-home-text-photo-1.es: * Sientes que este marco\nseguirá vacío por mucho tiempo.

worldcutscene-home-text-toys-2.english: * Toys.\n[wait:5]* You're way too old for them.
worldcutscene-home-text-toys-2.es: * Juguetes.\n[wait:5]* Ya eres demasiado mayor para ellos.

worldcutscene-home-text-diary-2.english: * It's Toriel's diary.\n[wait:5]* Out of respect,[wait:5] you refuse\nto read it.
worldcutscene-home-text-diary-2.es: * Es el diario de Toriel.\n[wait:5]* Por respeto,[wait:5] te niegas\na leerlo.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed2-2.english: * You're pretty sure this bed is\nQueen sized.
worldcutscene-home-text-bed2-2.es: * Estás casi seguro de que esta cama es\ntamaño queen.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair-3.english: * For some reason,[wait:5] you can't\nhelp but feel sad that it\nlacks a name.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair-3.es: * Por alguna razón,[wait:5] no puedes\nevitar sentir pena de que\nno tenga nombre.

worldcutscene-home-text-socks-2.es: * Es el cajón de calcetines de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-socks-3.english: * Why does she have this?[wait:5]\n* She doesn't even wear socks??
worldcutscene-home-text-socks-3.es: * ¿Por qué tiene esto?[wait:5]\n* ¡¿Ni siquiera usa calcetines?!

worldcutscene-home-text-cactus-2.english: * A cactus.[wait:5]\n* Doesn't look like it needles\nany help.
worldcutscene-home-text-cactus-2.es: * Un cactus.[wait:5]\n* No parece necesitar\nque le echen una mano.

worldcutscene-home-text-shelf2-2.english: * Not even a single speck\nof dust.

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-1.english: * This is not the way out.

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-2.english: * Toriel is waiting for you in the kitchen!

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-3.english: * You're too hungry to explore\nthe Ruins,[wait:5] breakfast first!
worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-3.es: * Tienes demasiada hambre para explorar\nlas Ruinas,[wait:5] ¡primero el desayuno!

worldcutscene-home-text-basement-1.english: * This is the exit.[wait:5]\n* Toriel says it's unsafe.
worldcutscene-home-text-basement-1.es: * Esta es la salida.[wait:5]\n* Toriel dice que no es seguro.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-1.english: * Don't take any more than\nyou've already taken.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-1.es: * No cojas más de lo que\nya has cogido.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-2.english: * For some reason,[wait:5] Toriel keeps\nbuying chocolate for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-2.es: * Por alguna razón,[wait:5] Toriel sigue\ncomprándote chocolate.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-3.english: * You don't really like chocolate,[wait:5] but you'll eat it if it makes her happy.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-3.es: * No te gusta mucho el chocolate,[wait:5] pero lo comerás si eso la hace feliz.

worldcutscene-home-text-sink-1.english: * You wash your hands.\n[wait:5]* Hygiene is important.
worldcutscene-home-text-sink-1.es: * Te lavas las manos.\n[wait:5]* La higiene es importante.

worldcutscene-home-text-sink-2.english: * There's some white fur stuck in the drain.
worldcutscene-home-text-sink-2.es: * Hay algo de pelo blanco atascado en el desagüe.

worldcutscene-home-text-counter-2.english: * The counter is clean.[wait:5]\n* Toriel likes to keep it tidy.
worldcutscene-home-text-counter-2.es: * La encimera está limpia.[wait:5]\n* A Toriel le gusta mantenerla ordenada.

worldcutscene-home-text-stove-1.es: * Ya has aprendido suficiente.[wait:5]\n* Todo está listo.

worldcutscene-home-text-stove-2.english: * You don't understand why Toriel \nhas this.[wait:5] She just uses fire \nmagic,[wait:5] anyway.
worldcutscene-home-text-stove-2.es: * No entiendes por qué Toriel \ntiene esto.[wait:5] Solo usa magia \nde fuego,[wait:5] al fin y al cabo.

worldcutscene-home-text-tree-1.english: * The leaf has fallen from the tree,[wait:5] joining its dead fellows beneath.
worldcutscene-home-text-tree-1.es: * La hoja ha caído del árbol,[wait:5] uniéndose a sus compañeras muertas de abajo.

worldcutscene-home-text-tree-2.english: * A single leaf hangs weakly from the old tree's weathered branch.
worldcutscene-home-text-tree-2.es: * Una sola hoja cuelga débilmente de la rama gastada del viejo árbol.

worldcutscene-home-text-save-1.english: * (The assurance that you're doing the right thing fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-home-text-save-1.es: * (La certeza de que estás haciendo lo correcto te llena de determinación.)

worldcutscene-home-text-save-2.english: * (The sight of \"Home\" fills you with a constricting,[wait:5] conflicted feeling.)
worldcutscene-home-text-save-2.es: * (La vista del \"Hogar\" te llena de una sensación opresiva,[wait:5] y contradictoria.)

worldcutscene-home-text-papers-1.es: * \"¡La Guardia Real te necesita a TI!\"

worldcutscene-home-text-papers-2.english: * \"Now hiring for the Royal Guard canteen position![wait:5]\n* Must be proficient in:\"
worldcutscene-home-text-papers-2.es: * \"¡Se busca personal para la cantina de la Guardia Real![wait:5]\n* Debe saber:\"

worldcutscene-home-text-papers-4.english: * \"If this describes you,[wait:5] sign up today![wait:5]\n* DO YOUR BARK!\"
worldcutscene-home-text-papers-4.es: * \"Si eso te describe,[wait:5] ¡apúntate hoy![wait:5]\n* ¡DA TU LADRIDO!\"

worldcutscene-home-text-papers-5.english: [wait:10]* Another one.[wait:5] It reads: \n[wait:10]* \"Keep an eye out for humans![wait:5] Help us reach the Sun!\"
worldcutscene-home-text-papers-5.es: [wait:10]* Otro más.[wait:5] Dice: \n[wait:10]* \"¡Vigila a los humanos![wait:5] ¡Ayúdanos a llegar al Sol!\"

worldcutscene-home-text-papers-6.english: [wait:10]* Upon another viewing,[wait:5] you \nnotice that the Royal Guard flier is slightly vandalized.
worldcutscene-home-text-papers-6.es: [wait:10]* Al mirarlo otra vez,[wait:5] notas \nque el folleto de la Guardia Real está ligeramente vandalizado.

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-textChoicer-jq-.english: * Enough explaining![wait:5]\n* Want to try a quiz?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-20.english: * Heeeellooo dear contestant![wait:5]\n* I'm the ringleader of questions and answers...

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-22.english: * You look new here!\n[wait:5]* No problem,[wait:5] the rules are elementary!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-22.es: * ¡Pareces nuevo por aquí!\n[wait:5]* No pasa nada,[wait:5] ¡las reglas son elementales!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-23.english: * QUIZ RULES![wait:5]\n* I ask questions,[wait:5] and you answer them!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-23.es: * ¡REGLAS DEL QUIZ![wait:5]\n* ¡Yo hago preguntas,[wait:5] y tú respondes!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-24.english: * If you WIN,[wait:5] you get a prize![wait:5]\n* If you LOSE,[wait:5] too bad!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-24.es: * ¡Si GANAS,[wait:5] recibes un premio![wait:5]\n* Si PIERDES,[wait:5] mala suerte!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-26.english: * Come back when you want to\n* QUIZ,[wait:5] MA!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-28.english: * Oh dear,[wait:5] I'm afraid that's wrong...[wait:5] And that means the quiz is over!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-28.es: * Ay,[wait:5] me temo que es incorrecto...[wait:5] ¡Y eso significa que el quiz ha terminado!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-29.english: * But don't despair![wait:5] Perhaps next time you'll be fit for the title of quizmaster.
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-29.es: * ¡Pero no desesperes![wait:5] Quizá la próxima vez seas digno del título de quizmaster.

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-30.english: * Until then,[wait:5] keep quizzing![wait:5]\n* And adieu from \n* JOE![wait:5] QUIZMA!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-30.es: * Hasta entonces,[wait:5] ¡sigue quizeando![wait:5]\n* Y adiós de parte de \n* ¡JOE![wait:5] QUIZMA!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-31.english: * Quiztion 1:[wait:5] Which day of the week is Time Ltd. closed?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-32.english: * Ding ding ding!![wait:5]\n* Quiz CORRECT![wait:5]\n* Time for quiztion 2!!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-33.english: * Quiztion 2:[wait:5] What's the name of the fellow carrying the mail in the Square?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-34.english: * Hmm,[wait:5] perhaps you were misremembering?[wait:5] Let's see if \nyou were right...

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-35.english: * Wow![wait:5] Incredible![wait:5]\n* I bet you weren't even worried!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-37.english: * Quiztion 3:[wait:5] Where is that firey kid that works with you from?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-38.english: * How would you know that,[wait:5] he's not very talkative,[wait:5] after all...
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-38.es: * ¿Cómo ibas a saberlo,[wait:5] si no habla mucho,[wait:5] después de todo...?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-39.english: * Perhaps just a guess...[wait:5]\n* But is it a lucky guess?

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-40.english: * Seems the answer is yes![wait:5] But don't celebrate yet,[wait:5] there's more quiztions ahead!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-40.es: * ¡Parece que sí![wait:5] Pero no lo celebres aún,[wait:5] ¡quedan más quizguntas!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-42.english: * Incredible![wait:5] You've proven that you're a real QUIZMASTER!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-43.english: * Take your prize![wait:5] It's a certified Quizma gift!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-45.english: * But! [wait:5]This is only the beginning![wait:5] More prizes await if you partake in future quizzes!
worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-45.es: * ¡Pero! [wait:5]¡Esto es solo el comienzo![wait:5] ¡Te esperan más premios en futuros quizzes!

worldcutscene-joe_quizma-text-jq-46.english: * Are you Quizma enough to \nquiz'em all?[wait:5] Only one way to \nanswer THAT quiztion...
