worldcutscene-office-text-courier-19.english: * What he means is he was fired from the UGPS,[wait:5] GWAHAHA!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-19.es: * Lo que quiere decir es que lo despidieron de UGPS,[wait:5] ¡GWAHAHA!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-20.english: * Hey![wait:5] All that means is that they couldn't HANDLE me!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-20.es: * ¡Oye![wait:5] ¡Eso solo significa que no pudieron CONMIGO!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-22.english: * None knew him,[wait:5] much less what shady deals he'd delivered...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-22.es: * Nadie lo conocía,[wait:5] mucho menos los negocios turbios que entregaba...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-23.english: * Known only by a title that sent chills down the spine of any who heard it...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-23.es: * Conocido solo por un título que helaba la sangre de quien lo oyera...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-25.english: * Alright!\n* Well,[wait:5] I'm Luna,[wait:5] manager of the Eclipse!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-26.english: * The soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the Underground!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-27.english: * Having the opportunity to share our food with everyone is wonderful!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-27.es: * ¡Tener la oportunidad de compartir nuestra comida con todos es maravilloso!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-28.english: * I'm sure it'll be a pleasure to work with you,[wait:5] Mr. Courier.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-28.es: * Estoy seguro de que será un placer trabajar con usted,[wait:5] Sr. Courier.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-32.english: * Listen.[wait:5] Is this really the best use you have for me?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-32.es: * Escucha.[wait:5] ¿De verdad este es el mejor uso que tienes para mí?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-33.english: * Running delivery boy for some...[wait:5] second-rate Hotland restaurant?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-33.es: * ¿Hacer de repartidor para algún...[wait:5] restaurante de segunda de Hotland?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-34.english: * I am a man with a very particular set of skills beyond simple mailman.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-34.es: * Tengo habilidades muy particulares además de repartir correo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-35.english: * Surely there must be better uses of my time than something so foolish.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-35.es: * Seguro que hay mejores usos para mi tiempo que algo tan absurdo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-36.english: * I knew you underestimated me,[wait:5] but this is just utterly demeaning-[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-36.es: * Sabía que me subestimabas,[wait:5] pero esto es completamente humillante-[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-38.english: * Guess Gull Skull's gonna miss out on all those sweet,[wait:5] tasty treats!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-38.es: * ¡Parece que Cráneo de Gaviota se perderá todas esas golosinas dulces,[wait:5] y sabrosas!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-39.english: * They're just BEGGIN' for someone to peck into them,[wait:5] too...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-39.es: * Además están casi ROGANDO que alguien les dé unos picotazos,[wait:5] también...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-41.english: * Ooo,[wait:5] and as a worker?[wait:5]\n* They were gonna be [wave]free...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-43.english: * But not because of the treats![wait:5] For completely unrelated reasons.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-43.es: * ¡Pero no por las golosinas![wait:5] Por razones totalmente distintas.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-45.english: * I am a professional,[wait:5] far better than to stoop so low as dumb \"treats\".
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-45.es: * Soy un profesional,[wait:5] muy por encima de rebajarme por simples \"golosinas\".

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-47.english: * ...What kind of treats are we talking here?[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-47.es: * ...¿De qué tipo de golosinas estamos hablando?[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-48.english: * Hey,[wait:5] fuzz.\n[wait:5]* Why don't you show Gull Skull around the place?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-48.es: * Oye,[wait:5] peluche.\n[wait:5]* ¿Por qué no le enseñas el lugar a Cráneo de Gaviota?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-49.english: * Get him real acquainted with your dream project.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-49.es: * Haz que conozca bien tu proyecto soñado.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-51.english: * Oh![wait:5] I'd love to![wait:5]\n* Come on,[wait:5] Mr. Courier,[wait:5] you'll love it.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-51.es: * ¡Oh![wait:5] ¡Me encantaría![wait:5]\n* Vamos,[wait:5] Sr. Courier,[wait:5] le encantará.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-53.english: * The little chum and I have some things to discuss.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-53.es: * El peque y yo tenemos unas cosas que discutir.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-56.english: * Fine.[wait:5]\n* Show me around the place,[wait:5] then.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-56.es: * Está bien.[wait:5]\n* Entonces enséñame el lugar,[wait:5] anda.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-57.english: * I'm just...[wait:5] thrilled.[wait:5]\n* To see the,[wait:5] uh...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-57.es: * Estoy simplemente...[wait:5] emocionado.[wait:5]\n* Por ver las,[wait:5] eh...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-59.english: * Really?[wait:5] Well,[wait:5] I'd be more than glad to show them off!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-60.english: * They're not exactly state of the art right now,
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-60.es: * Ahora mismo no son precisamente de última generación,

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-61.english: * But I just know that before long they'll be world class.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-61.es: * Pero sé que muy pronto serán de primera categoría mundial.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-62.english: * Come on,[wait:5] I'll tell you anything you want to know!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-62.es: * ¡Vamos,[wait:5] te contaré todo lo que quieras saber!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-64.english: * Fuzz is quite the character,[wait:5] aren't they?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-66.english: * Ya know,[wait:5] I wasn't lying when I said I liked their ambition.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-66.es: * Sabes,[wait:5] no mentía cuando dije que me gustaba la ambición de Luna.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-67.english: * They got a real hustler's spark,[wait:5] no doubt about that!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-67.es: * ¡Tiene la chispa de alguien que sabe buscarse la vida,[wait:5] sin duda!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-69.english: * The things that make a mighty monster,[wait:5] ya feel me?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-69.es: * Las cosas que hacen a un monstruo poderoso,[wait:5] ¿me entiendes?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-70.english: * Heh,[wait:5] maybe ya don't.\n[wait:5]* I can't blame ya,[wait:5] I suppose.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-70.es: * Je,[wait:5] quizá no.\n[wait:5]* No puedo culparte,[wait:5] supongo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-71.english: * What would you really know about that,[wait:5] anyway?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-71.es: * Después de todo,[wait:5] ¿qué sabrías tú de eso?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-72.english: * How about this?\n[wait:5]* Let me put it in a way you'll understand.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-72.es: * ¿Qué tal esto?\n[wait:5]* Te lo diré de una forma que entiendas.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-73.english: * There's another word that I feel describes it perfectly.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-73.es: * Hay otra palabra que creo que lo describe perfectamente.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-74.english: * Hmmmm...[wait:5]\n* It's on the tip of my tongue...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-74.es: * Hmmmm...[wait:5]\n* La tengo en la punta de la lengua...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-76.english: * Fuzz's pretty determined to make this whole Eclipse thing work out.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-76.es: * Ese peluche tiene mucha determinación para hacer que todo lo del Eclipse funcione.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-77.english: * They've put everything they have into this!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-77.es: * ¡Luna lo ha dado todo por esto!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-78.english: * Ah,[wait:5] but I'm preaching to the choir.[wait:5] You know that better than anyone.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-78.es: * Ah,[wait:5] pero estoy predicando al coro.[wait:5] Tú lo sabes mejor que nadie.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-79.english: * Like I said,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] you two are sardines in a can!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-79.es: * Como dije,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] ¡ustedes dos son sardinas en la misma lata!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-80.english: * So what about you?[wait:5]\n* What are you getting out of this?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-81.english: * I wanna understand.[wait:5]\n* What are you determined to do?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-81.es: * Quiero entender.[wait:5]\n* ¿Qué estás decidido a hacer?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-84.english: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* You're an even bigger fool than I thought!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-84.es: * ¡GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* ¡Eres aún más necio de lo que pensaba!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-85.english: * Listen,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\n* I'll be blunt with ya.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-85.es: * Escucha,[wait:5] colega.[wait:5]\n* Voy a ser directo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-86.english: * The fuzzball's dream is a load of barnacles.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-86.es: * El sueño de la bola de pelo es un montón de percebes.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-87.english: * A restaurant that will change the world?\n[wait:5]* Break the barrier?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-87.es: * ¿Un restaurante que cambiará el mundo?\n[wait:5]* ¿Romper la barrera?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-88.english: * Be remembered forever?[wait:5]\n* It's not happening.[wait:5]\n[wait:5]* Can't happen.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-88.es: * ¿Ser recordado para siempre?[wait:5]\n* No va a pasar.[wait:5]\n[wait:5]* No puede pasar.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-89.english: * You can't change people with just a smile and some good food.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-89.es: * No puedes cambiar a la gente solo con una sonrisa y buena comida.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-91.english: * We both know this story can only end one way.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-91.es: * Ambos sabemos que esto solo puede acabar de una forma.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-92.english: * And I'm afraid it ain't good for either of you.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-92.es: * Y me temo que no será bueno para ninguno de ustedes.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-93.english: * Huh?[wait:5] Why am I investing in this,[wait:5] then?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-93.es: * ¿Eh?[wait:5] ¿Entonces por qué estoy invirtiendo en esto,[wait:5] dices?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-95.english: * Oh,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] I said it wasn't good for YOU.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-95.es: * Oh,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] dije que no sería bueno para TI.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-96.english: * As for me?[wait:5]\n* Well,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] let's just say...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-96.es: * ¿Y para mí?[wait:5]\n* Bueno,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] digamos simplemente...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-97.english: *[font:main_italic] Your soul makes for some pretty prized collateral.[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-97.es: *[font:main_italic] Tu ALMA es una garantía bastante valiosa.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-98.english: * Hm,[wait:5] you don't look very surprised,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-98.es: * Hm,[wait:5] no pareces muy sorprendido,[wait:5] colega.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-99.english: * Maybe you were smart enough to figure that out on your own,[wait:5] then.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-99.es: * Quizá lo descubriste por tu cuenta,[wait:5] entonces.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-100.english: *[font:main_italic] Or maybe you already figured out the hard way?[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-100.es: *[font:main_italic] ¿O quizá ya lo descubriste por las malas?[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-102.english: * Imagine,[wait:5] hypothetically,[wait:5] that you had some sort of special power.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-102.es: * Imagina,[wait:5] hipotéticamente,[wait:5] que tuvieras algún tipo de poder especial.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-103.english: * Why waste it on a measly restaurant?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-103.es: * ¿Por qué gastarlo en un simple restaurante?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-104.english: * With a power like that,[wait:5] the world's your oyster![wait:5] You could do anything!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-104.es: * ¡Con un poder así,[wait:5] el mundo es tu ostra![wait:5] Podrías hacer cualquier cosa!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-105.english: * You could become the most powerful being in the Underground!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-105.es: * ¡Podrías convertirte en el ser más poderoso del Subsuelo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-106.english: * You could easily make it past Asgore and return home,[wait:5] if you wanted.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-106.es: * Podrías superar fácilmente a Asgore y volver a casa,[wait:5] si quisieras.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-107.english: * But you won't.[wait:5]\n* Because you want to be \"good\" and \"kind\".
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-107.es: * Pero no lo harás.[wait:5]\n* Porque quieres ser \"buena persona\" y \"amable\".

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-108.english: * But how kind can ya really be when you've got nothin' to lose?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-108.es: * ¿Pero cuánta bondad hay de verdad cuando no tienes nada que perder?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-109.english: * You think you're being \"selfless\",[wait:5] but face it.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-109.es: * Crees que estás siendo \"altruista\",[wait:5] pero afronta la realidad.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-110.english: * You're just as selfish as the rest of us.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-110.es: * Eres igual de egoísta que el resto de nosotros.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-111.english: * So go ahead![wait:5]\n* Keep prancin' around,[wait:5] playing the noble hero.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-111.es: * ¡Así que adelante![wait:5]\n* Sigue dando saltitos por ahí,[wait:5] jugando a ser el noble héroe.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-112.english: * If that's what helps you sleep at night.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-112.es: * Si eso te ayuda a dormir por las noches.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-113.english: * But you know where that's gonna getcha?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-114.english: *[font:main_italic] A coffin with a name that no one remembers.[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-114.es: *[font:main_italic] Un ataúd con un nombre que nadie recuerda.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-115.english: * That's it.[wait:5] Stole the word right out of my mouth.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-115.es: * Eso.[wait:5] Me quitaste la palabra de la boca.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-116.english: * Almost like you already knew what I was gonna say.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-116.es: * Casi como si ya supieras lo que iba a decir.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-117.english: * Hah![wait:5] If you could see the look on your face!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-118.es: * Ahora eso...[wait:5]\n* Eso no tiene precio.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-119.english: * So.[wait:5] This ain't your first rodeo,[wait:5] eh?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-119.es: * Entonces.[wait:5] No es tu primer rodeo,[wait:5] ¿eh?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-121.english: * Did you want to see how much more GOLD and PRESTIGE you could get?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-121.es: * ¿Querías ver cuánto más ORO y PRESTIGIO podías conseguir?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-122.english: * Maybe you thought you could make it to an even higher rank!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-122.es: * ¡Quizá pensaste que podrías llegar a un rango aún más alto!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-123.english: * Now that'd be the kind of moxie I can respect!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-123.es: * ¡Eso sí sería el tipo de agallas que respeto!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-124.english: *[wait:5] ...But something tells me it ain't that simple.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-124.es: *[wait:5] ...Pero algo me dice que no es tan sencillo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-125.english: * Were you trying to find a way out of this bind?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-125.es: * ¿Intentabas encontrar una salida de este aprieto?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-126.english: * Trying to find a way this whole shebang could end differently?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-126.es: * ¿Intentando encontrar una forma de que todo este asunto acabara distinto?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-127.english: * I dunno how clear I gotta make it to ya,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-127.es: * No sé cuánto más claro tengo que dejarlo,[wait:5] colega.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-128.english: * You can't change your fate without changing who you are.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-128.es: * No puedes cambiar tu destino sin cambiar quién eres.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-129.english: * And you know what you are?[wait:5] What you've always been?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-129.es: * ¿Y sabes lo que eres?[wait:5] ¿Lo que siempre has sido?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-130.english: *[font:main_italic] Just a SOUL in a jar.[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-130.es: *[font:main_italic] Solo un ALMA en un frasco.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-131.english: * Alright,[wait:5] I've shown Mr. Courier every corner of The Eclipse!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-131.es: * Bien,[wait:5] ¡le enseñé cada rincón del Eclipse al Sr. Courier!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-132.english: * It's getting really late though,[wait:5] so we really should lock up.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-132.es: * Pero se está haciendo muy tarde,[wait:5] así que deberíamos cerrar.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-133.english: * Did you two talk about everything you needed?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-134.english: * Sure did,[wait:5] fuzz![wait:5] Sorry for keeping the little chum for so long.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-134.es: * Claro que sí,[wait:5] peluche.[wait:5] Perdón por retener al peque tanto tiempo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-135.english: * I should probably head off myself.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-136.english: * Not even nighttime can stop a savvy shark like me from making money!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-136.es: * ¡Ni la noche impide que un tiburón listo como yo gane dinero!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-139.english: * I spent a whole night fixing up the Eclipse,[wait:5] after all.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-139.es: * Después de todo,[wait:5] me pasé una noche entera arreglando el Eclipse.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-140.english: * Anything to make it stand the test of time!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-140.es: * ¡Lo que sea para que resista el paso del tiempo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-141.english: * Anyway,[wait:5] let's go,[wait:5] Sunny.\n[wait:5]* Tomorrow is another day!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-141.es: * En fin,[wait:5] vamos,[wait:5] Sunny.\n[wait:5]* ¡Mañana será otro día!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-142.english: * Think about what I said,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-142.es: * Piensa en lo que te dije,[wait:5] colega.

worldcutscene-office-text-no_leave-1.english: * Come on, chum!\n[wait:5]* No need to be afraid. I won't bite!
worldcutscene-office-text-no_leave-1.es: * ¡Vamos, colega!\n[wait:5]* No hace falta tener miedo. ¡No muerdo!

worldcutscene-office-text-luna-1.english: * (Did he just have this office ready...?)

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-1.english: * Taken in by the patented Mawzzmobile(tm),[wait:5] eh?
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-1.es: * Te ha llamado la atención la Mawzzmobile(tm) patentada,[wait:5] ¿eh?

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-2.english: * She's a real beaut,[wait:5] aint she?[wait:5]\n* Custom made,[wait:5] too!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-2.es: * Es una belleza,[wait:5] ¿no?[wait:5]\n* Hecha a medida,[wait:5] además!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-3.english: * I know,[wait:5] I know.[wait:5]\n* \"Why's she in a bottle?\"\n[wait:5]* \"Does she work?\"
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-3.es: * Ya sé,[wait:5] ya sé.[wait:5]\n* \"¿Por qué está en una botella?\"\n[wait:5]* \"¿Funciona?\"

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-4.english: * Come on,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] who do you take me for![wait:5]\n* She drives like a dream!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-4.es: * Vamos,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] ¡¿por quién me tomas?![wait:5]\n* ¡Se conduce como un sueño!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-5.english: * I'm just keeping her safe until I...[wait:5]
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-5.es: * Solo la mantengo a salvo hasta que...[wait:5]

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-6.english: * Persuade.[wait:5]\n* Asgore to build a highway.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-6.es: * Convenza.[wait:5]\n* A Asgore de construir una autopista.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-7.english: * Trust me,[wait:5] chum.\n[wait:5]* The highway will be great for the economy!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-7.es: * Confía en mí,[wait:5] colega.\n[wait:5]* ¡La autopista será genial para la economía!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-8.english: * No one else has a car,[wait:5] so traffic will be no problem.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-8.es: * Nadie más tiene coche,[wait:5] así que el tráfico no será problema.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-9.english: * You know,[wait:5] back in my youth,[wait:5] I used to be a real seahorsegirl.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-9.es: * Sabes,[wait:5] de joven,[wait:5] yo era toda una chica-caballito-de-mar.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-10.english: * I really wanted to be best friends with a seahorse!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-10.es: * ¡Quería muchísimo ser la mejor amiga de un caballito de mar!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-11.english: * Taking care of it,[wait:5] feeding it,[wait:5] saving it from mean owners...
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-11.es: * Cuidarlo,[wait:5] alimentarlo,[wait:5] salvarlo de dueños malvados...

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-12.english: * If I had a strong bond with one,[wait:5] maybe it'd let me ride it.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-12.es: * Si tuviera un vínculo fuerte con uno,[wait:5] quizá me dejaría montarlo.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-14.english: * Who needs seahorses when you've got the power of a THOUSAND of em?!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-14.es: * ¡¿Quién necesita caballitos de mar cuando tienes la potencia de MIL de ellos?!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-15.english: * The patented Mawzzmobile(tm).\n[wait:5]* Seems to have a lot of HP.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-15.es: * La Mawzzmobile(tm) patentada.\n[wait:5]* Parece tener muchos PV.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-1.english: * I see you're appreciating the art.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-1.es: * Veo que estás apreciando el arte.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-2.english: * I'm quite the patron of them.\n[wait:5]* It's true!

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-3.english: * These two are part of my personal collection.[wait:5] Masterpieces!
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-3.es: * Estas dos forman parte de mi colección personal.[wait:5] ¡Obras maestras!

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-4.english: * They really highlight the two most important things in life.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-4.es: * De verdad destacan las dos cosas más importantes de la vida.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-6.english: * Two very valuable paintings of supposedly valuable things.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-6.es: * Dos pinturas muy valiosas de cosas supuestamente valiosas.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-7.english: * But are they themselves valuable,[wait:5] or simply representations of value?
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-7.es: * ¿Pero son valiosas por sí mismas,[wait:5] o solo representaciones del valor?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-1.english: * Hey.[wait:5]\n* Don't get any funny ideas,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-1.es: * Oye.[wait:5]\n* Nada de ideas raras,[wait:5] colega.

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-2.english: * People always assume all my wealth is in my net worth,[wait:5] in assets.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-2.es: * Siempre creen que toda mi riqueza está en el patrimonio,[wait:5] en activos.

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-3.english: * GWAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Imbeciles,[wait:5] the lot of them!

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-4.english: * What's the point in being rich if you can't swim in your money?
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-4.es: * ¿Qué gracia tiene ser rica si no puedes nadar en tu propio dinero?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-5.english: * Liquid wealth all the way,[wait:5] chum!

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-6.english: * That's why that safe is watertight,[wait:5] see?
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-6.es: * Por eso esa caja fuerte es impermeable,[wait:5] ¿ves?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-7.english: * Mawzz's money safe.[wait:5]\n* You can hear sloshing inside.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-7.es: * La caja fuerte de Mawzz.[wait:5]\n* Se oye líquido dentro.

worldcutscene-office-text-unders_tale-1.english: * Your [color:red]under tale[color:white] will not be remembered.

worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.es: [voice:ut]* Las buenas personas nunca son egoístas.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* Las buenas personas ponen a los demás primero.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.english: [voice:ut]* Good people would do anything for others.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.es: [voice:ut]* Las buenas personas harían cualquier cosa por los demás.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* La gente mala les quita cosas a otros.[wait:10]
[voice:ut]* La gente mala hace daño a otros.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.english: [voice:ut]* Bad people only think of themselves.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.es: [voice:ut]* Las malas personas solo piensan en sí mismas.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-8.english: * After so long,[wait:5] I'm finally back on track to reaching my dream.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-8.es: * Después de tanto tiempo,[wait:5] por fin vuelvo a estar en camino de cumplir mi sueño.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-10.english: [wait:20]* Well,[wait:5] we didn't really come up with a name,[wait:5] did we?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-10.es: [wait:20]* Bueno,[wait:5] en realidad no pensamos un nombre,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-11.english: * Hmmm.[wait:5][speed:0.1]..[speed:1][wait:25] \n* I'm sure it'll come to me eventually.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-11.es: * Hmmm.[wait:5][speed:0.1]..[speed:1][wait:25] \n* Seguro que tarde o temprano se me ocurrirá algo.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-12.english: * Thank you so much,[wait:5] Sunny![wait:5] You were a great help!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-12.es: * ¡Muchas gracias,[wait:5] Sunny![wait:5] ¡Has sido de gran ayuda!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-13.english: [wait:5]* Heh.[wait:5] Listen to me![wait:5] Talking as if it's already all done.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-13.es: [wait:5]* Je.[wait:5] ¡Mírame![wait:5] Hablando como si ya estuviera todo hecho.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-14.english: * No,[wait:5] we've still got a long way to go before that dream is achieved.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-14.es: * No,[wait:5] aún nos queda mucho camino para hacer realidad ese sueño.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-15.english: * But still,[wait:5] today was a big step taken towards it!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-15.es: * Pero aun así,[wait:5] ¡hoy dimos un gran paso hacia él!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-16.english: * Day after day,[wait:5] little by little,[wait:5] we'll finally reach the stars!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-16.es: * Día tras día,[wait:5] poco a poco,[wait:5] ¡al final llegaremos a las estrellas!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-19.english: * I want to show you something!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-21.english: * Wait...[wait:5] \n* I forgot you can't fly.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-21.es: * Espera...[wait:5] \n* Olvidé que no puedes volar.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-23.english: * Here,[wait:5] let me try to help you up.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-23.es: * Ven,[wait:5] déjame intentar ayudarte a subir.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-25.english: * Don't worry about me,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* I'm good.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-25.es: * No te preocupes por mí,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* Estoy bien.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-26.english: * Just not used to-[wait:5]\n*[font:main_italic][face:yeesh] Cough Cough-[wait:5][font:main_mono][face:woo]\n* Carrying anyone.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-26.es: * Solo que no tengo costumbre de-[wait:5]\n*[font:main_italic][face:yeesh] Cof Cof-[wait:5][font:main_mono][face:woo]\n* Cargar a alguien.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-28.english: * Ahem.[wait:5] Anyway.[wait:5] \n* Here's what I wanted to show you...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-28.es: * Ejem.[wait:5] En fin.[wait:5] \n* Esto es lo que quería enseñarte...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-29.english: * It's not often you get to see the CORE where you're from.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-29.es: * No es frecuente poder ver el NÚCLEO desde donde vienes.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-31.english: * You were freezing when I found you,[wait:5] so I assumed as much.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-31.es: * Estabas congelándote cuando te encontré,[wait:5] así que lo supuse.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-33.english: * My dad actually helped build it a long time ago!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-33.es: * ¡Mi padre ayudó a construirlo hace mucho tiempo!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-34.english: * Ah,[wait:5] but that's not what I wanted to show you.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-34.es: * Ah,[wait:5] pero eso no era lo que quería enseñarte.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-37.english: * We wanted to replicate the surface's day and night cycle down here-
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-37.es: * Queríamos reproducir aquí abajo el ciclo de día y noche de la superficie-

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-38.english: * So they made the CORE shut off its lights each night!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-38.es: * ¡Así que hicieron que el NÚCLEO apague sus luces cada noche!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-39.english: * It's not the real thing,[wait:5] of course,[wait:5] but it's what we have.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-39.es: * No es lo auténtico,[wait:5] claro,[wait:5] pero es lo que tenemos.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-40.english: * It makes me wonder what the real sky,[wait:5] the real day and night look like.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-40.es: * Me hace preguntarme cómo serán el cielo de verdad,[wait:5] el día y la noche de verdad.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-41.english: * All those stars...[wait:5] \n* The Sun...[wait:15][speed:0.8] \n* The Moon...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-41.es: * Todas esas estrellas...[wait:5] \n* El Sol...[wait:15][speed:0.8] \n* La Luna...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-42.english: * Few monsters alive ever had the privilege of seeing them.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-42.es: * Pocos monstruos vivos han tenido el privilegio de verlos.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-43.english: * But those that did speak so highly of the experience...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-43.es: * Pero quienes los vieron hablan maravillas de la experiencia...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-44.english: * [wait:10]I've never been able to stop wondering.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-46.english: * [speed:1.4]Did you know that the Moon rotates around the whole earth?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-46.es: * [speed:1.4]¿Sabías que la Luna gira alrededor de toda la Tierra?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-47.english: * [speed:1.4]And the Earth itself is orbiting the Sun!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-47.es: * [speed:1.4]¡Y la propia Tierra orbita alrededor del Sol!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-48.english: * [speed:1.4]And sometimes...[wait:15] They all line up just right and make an eclipse!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-48.es: * [speed:1.4]Y a veces...[wait:15] ¡Todo se alinea a la perfección y forma un eclipse!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-51.english: * I know what we're going to call the restaurant!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-51.es: * ¡Sé cómo vamos a llamar al restaurante!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-52.english: * The Sun and Moon coming together,[wait:5] a once-in-a-\nlifetime event...!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-52.es: * El Sol y la Luna uniéndose,[wait:5] un evento único en la\nvida...!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-53.english: * That's it![wait:5] \n* The Eclipse![wait:5] \n* It's perfect!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-54.english: * A restaurant that manages to capture the beauty of the surface...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-54.es: * Un restaurante capaz de capturar la belleza de la superficie...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-55.english: * ...All in this tiny corner of Hotland.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-55.es: * ...Todo en este pequeño rincón de Hotland.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-56.es: * Un restaurante que le gustará a todo el mundo.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-57.english: * So good,[wait:5] even the King himself would happily dine at it!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-57.es: * ¡Tan bueno,[wait:5] que hasta el propio Rey comería allí encantado!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-58.english: * Now that'd be quite the photo to hang on the wall,[wait:5] don't you think?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-58.es: * Sería una buena foto para colgar en la pared,[wait:5] ¿no crees?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-59.english: * I feel like this is the first step in a new stage of our lives.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-59.es: * Siento que este es el primer paso de una nueva etapa de nuestras vidas.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-60.es: * ¡Hoy de verdad has demostrado lo que vales!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-61.english: * I know it may seem absurd,[wait:5] but somehow,[wait:5] someway...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-61.es: * Suena absurdo,[wait:5] pero de algún modo,[wait:5] de alguna manera...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-62.english: * I have a feeling that this restaurant-
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-62.es: * Tengo la sensación de que este restaurante-

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-64.english: * Will help us see the real sky someday.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-64.es: * Nos ayudará a ver el cielo de verdad algún día.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-65.english: * I know it's probably just wishful thinking,[wait:5] but...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-65.es: * Sé que probablemente solo son ilusiones,[wait:5] pero...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-66.english: * No matter what,[wait:5] I think we can do great things!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-66.es: * Pase lo que pase,[wait:5] ¡creo que podemos hacer grandes cosas!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-68.english: * Let's promise to keep working on this dream,[wait:5] no matter what happens.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-68.es: * Prometamos seguir trabajando por este sueño,[wait:5] pase lo que pase.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-69.english: * Let's shake on it.[wait:5] \n* For The Eclipse!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-69.es: * Sellemos el trato con un apretón.[wait:5] \n* ¡Por el Eclipse!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-70.english: * Thank you,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5] This means a lot to me.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-70.es: * Gracias,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5] Esto significa mucho para mí.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-71.english: * I hope it means a lot to you as well.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-71.es: * Espero que también signifique mucho para ti.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-72.english: * Now that's enough of that.[wait:5] \n* It's getting late.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-72.es: * Pero basta de eso.[wait:5] \n* Se está haciendo tarde.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-75.english: * Home's too restricting for our ambitions,[wait:5] isn't it?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-75.es: * El Hogar limita demasiado nuestras ambiciones,[wait:5] ¿no crees?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-76.english: * Don't worry,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* I've got you covered.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-76.es: * No te preocupes,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* Yo me encargo de ti.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-77.english: * If you have nowhere else to stay,[wait:5] you can stay at my place.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-77.es: * Si no tienes dónde quedarte,[wait:5] puedes alojarte en mi apartamento.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-78.english: * I mean,[wait:5] it's a little cramped,[wait:5] but you know,[wait:5] what place isn't?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-78.es: * Quiero decir,[wait:5] es un poco pequeña,[wait:5] pero ya sabes,[wait:5] ¿qué sitio no lo es?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-79.english: * Let's head back to my apartment,[wait:5] shall we?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-80.english: * Tomorrow is another day,[wait:5] after all.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-80.es: * Después de todo,[wait:5] mañana será otro día.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-81.es: ¡Favor Aceptado! \n[color:yellow]Sueños a la Luz de la Luna

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-82.english: * It has been added to your FAVORs.

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* The start of a whole new life...[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.es: [voice:ut]* El comienzo de una vida completamente nueva...[wait:60]

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* A way to make others happy.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.es: [voice:ut]* Una forma de hacer felices a los demás.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* Maybe Luna is right.[wait:10] \n* This really will \nbe something special.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.es: [voice:ut]* Quizá Luna tenga razón.[wait:10] \n* Esto de verdad va a \nser algo especial.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-2.english: * You see a room full of books\nand cozy places to read.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-2.es: * Ves una habitación llena de libros\ny rincones acogedores para leer.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-3.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* A monster with spectacles sits on a beanbag in the corner.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-3.es: * ...¡Oh![wait:5]\n* Un monstruo con gafas está sentado en un puf en la esquina.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-4.english: * They wave at you with a book in their other hand.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-4.es: * El monstruo te saluda con un libro en la otra mano.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-5.english: * You wave back.\n[wait:5]* They smile at you before turning back to their book.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-5.es: * Devuelves el saludo.\n[wait:5]* El monstruo te sonríe antes de volver al libro.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-6.english: * For some reason...[wait:5] You feel a little bit like crying.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-6.es: * Por alguna razón...[wait:5] Te dan un poco de ganas de llorar.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-2.english: * You see a room fighting in vain to ward away the heat.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-2.es: * Ves una habitación intentando en vano combatir el calor.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-3.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* An ice elemental is laying in the middle of the room.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-3.es: * ...¡Oh![wait:5]\n* Un elemental de hielo está tumbado en medio de la habitación.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-4.english: * They look like they're trying not to melt...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-5.english: * They shoot you a goopy thumbs up.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-5.es: * Te hace un pulgar arriba bastante viscoso.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-6.english: * Seems like they're just cooling off...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-7.english: * You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment2-7.es: * Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-2.english: * There's a monster staring at you from the dark!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-2.es: * ¡Hay un monstruo mirándote desde la oscuridad!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-3.english: * They hiss at you,[wait:5] but you bark back!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-4.english: * You feel bad about it...[wait:5] But the eyes nod in respect...?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-4.es: * Te sientes mal por eso...[wait:5] ¿Pero los ojos asienten con respeto...?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-5.english: * You're not quite sure what this means.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-5.es: * No tienes muy claro qué significa esto.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-6.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-6.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-7.english: * Seems like they're just cooling off...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-8.english: * The lights are on,[wait:5] yet no one\nis home...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment3-8.es: * Las luces están encendidas,[wait:5] pero no hay\nnadie en casa...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-2.english: * You see a room with far too\nmany heaters considering the context.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-2.es: * Ves una habitación con demasiados\ncalefactores para el contexto.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-3.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* A fire elemental is sitting in the corner of the room!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-3.es: * ...¡Oh![wait:5]\n* ¡Un elemental de fuego está sentado en la esquina!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-4.es: * ...¿con un abrigo de invierno y temblando...?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-6.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment4-6.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-2.english: * You see an imposing mystical\norb on a pedestal.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-2.es: * Ves una imponente esfera\nmística sobre un pedestal.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-3.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* Someone's walking towards the magic ball.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-3.es: * ...¡Oh![wait:5]\n* Alguien camina hacia la bola mágica.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-4.english: * Seems like you're neighbours with a hobbyist fortuneteller!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-4.es: * ¡Parece que tu vecino practica la adivinación por afición!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-5.es: * La persona ondula las manos de forma enigmática...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-6.english: * Seems like you'll need to\nreturn when you're more magically inclined...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment5-6.es: * Parece que tendrás que\nvolver cuando tengas más afinidad mágica...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-2.english: * Looks like a dorm.[wait:5]\n* A banner for Hotland University hangs on the wall.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-2.es: * Parece una residencia.[wait:5]\n* Una pancarta de la Universidad de Hotland cuelga de la pared.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-3.english: * You see a monster furiously pouring over textbooks with 6 arms.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-3.es: * Ves a un monstruo de 6 brazos estudiando frenéticamente entre libros.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-4.english: * It seems like you probably shouldn't bother them...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-4.es: * Parece que será mejor no molestar...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-5.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-5.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-6.english: * A dank smell emanates from the apartment...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-6.es: * Un olor húmedo emana del apartamento...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-7.english: * You wonder if this means the exam went well or poorly...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-7.es: * Te preguntas si eso significa que el examen fue bien o mal...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-8.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment6-8.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-2.english: * A delicious looking pie is cooling by the windowsill.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-2.es: * Una tarta deliciosa se enfría en el alféizar.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-4.english: * Seems as if there's pies cooling in every corner of the apartment...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-4.es: * Parece haber tartas enfriándose por todos los rincones del apartamento...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-5.english: * A monster floats between them,[wait:5] drawn in by the pies' aroma.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-5.es: * Un monstruo flota entre ellas,[wait:5] atraído por el aroma de las tartas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-6.english: * You think this might be what watching bumblebees is like.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-6.es: * Crees que debe de ser como observar abejorros.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-7.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment7-7.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-2.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* The child is laying under their covers.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-2.es: * ...¡Oh![wait:5]\n* La criatura está bajo las mantas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-3.english: * They seem to be secretly playing a handheld console...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-3.es: * Parece estar jugando a escondidas con una consola portátil...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-4.english: * They look up at you and put their pointer finger in front of their lips.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-4.es: * La criatura te mira y se pone el índice frente a los labios.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-5.english: * You make a zipping motion over your mouth and give them a wink.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-5.es: * Haces el gesto de cerrar la boca con cremallera y guiñas un ojo.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-6.english: * (You got some sicko intel.[wait:5]\n* Or something like that...)
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-6.es: * (Conseguiste algo de información de fisgón.[wait:5]\n* O algo así...)

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-7.english: * It looks like a child's bedroom.[wait:5] The child is probably asleep.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment8-7.es: * Parece el dormitorio de una criatura.[wait:5] Probablemente está durmiendo.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-2.english: * What?[wait:5]\n* I'm just a sicko that likes looking into people's windows.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-2.es: * ¿Qué?[wait:5]\n* Solo soy un fisgón al que le gusta mirar por las ventanas ajenas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-3.english: * There's something magical about getting a glimpse into others' lives,[wait:5] isn't there?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-3.es: * Hay algo mágico en echar un vistazo a la vida ajena,[wait:5] ¿no crees?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-4.english: * Piecing things together from what little you see...[wait:5] Ha ha!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-4.es: * Atar cabos con lo poco que ves...[wait:5] ¡Ja, ja!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-5.english: * Hmm,[wait:5] there's an air about you...\n[wait:5]* You know the feeling,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-5.es: * Hmm,[wait:5] hay algo en ti...\n[wait:5]* Conoces esa sensación,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-6.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* Sicko to sicko!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-7.english: * If you find out anything juicy about the residents here,[wait:5] let me know!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-7.es: * Si descubres algún detalle jugoso sobre los residentes,[wait:5] ¡cuéntamelo!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-8.english: * And if you need advice from a professional sicko,[wait:5] I have sicko's knowledge.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-8.es: * Y si necesitas consejo de un fisgón profesional,[wait:5] tengo conocimientos de fisgón.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-9.english: * My main piece of advice is to keep your sicko's eye on what lights are on or off.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-9.es: * Mi consejo principal es que tu ojo de fisgón vigile qué luces están encendidas o apagadas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-10.english: * If you want to see people,[wait:5] they'll usually have their lights on.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-10.es: * Si quieres ver gente,[wait:5] normalmente tendrán las luces encendidas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-11.english: * Also,[wait:5] try to keep people's weekly schedules in mind.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-11.es: * Además,[wait:5] intenta recordar los horarios semanales de la gente.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-12.english: * As you bring me juicy details,[wait:5] I'll tell you some intel I know!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-12.es: * A medida que me traigas detalles jugosos,[wait:5] ¡te contaré información que conozco!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-13.english: * Here's some sicko starter advice to start you off!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-13.es: * ¡Aquí tienes un consejo inicial de fisgón para empezar!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-14.english: * I heard the people free on Mondays have some sort of rivalry...[wait:5] Ooo la la!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-14.es: * Oí que quienes están libres los lunes tienen una especie de rivalidad...[wait:5] ¡Ooo la la!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-15.english: * Oh?[wait:5] You've got some sicko intel?[wait:5] Yes,[wait:5] yes,[wait:5] spill!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-16.english: * What's that?[wait:5] A fortune teller that waved you away?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-16.es: * ¿Qué?[wait:5] ¿Una persona que lee la fortuna y te echó?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-17.english: * Well,[wait:5] fortune telling works by reading your innate MAGIC...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-17.es: * Bueno,[wait:5] la adivinación funciona leyendo tu MAGIA innata...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-18.english: * It's very rare a monster has a MAGIC stat that low,[wait:5] but...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-18.es: * Es muy raro que un monstruo tenga una estadística de MAGIA tan baja,[wait:5] pero...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-19.english: * Just keep practicing your MAGIC.[wait:10]\nOnce it's high enough,[wait:5] try checking again on a Sunday!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-19.es: * Sigue practicando tu MAGIA.[wait:10]\nCuando sea lo bastante alta,[wait:5] ¡vuelve a mirar un domingo!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-20.english: * One monster with a room that's too hot and one that's too cold...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-20.es: * Un monstruo con una habitación demasiado caliente y otro demasiado fría...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-21.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* You can see where the rivalry may come in...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-21.es: * ¡Ja, ja![wait:5] ¡Sí![wait:5]\n* Se ve de dónde puede venir la rivalidad...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-22.english: * But let's not get hasty now![wait:5]\n* Let's see how it develops...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-22.es: * ¡Pero no nos precipitemos![wait:5]\n* Veamos cómo se desarrolla...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-23.english: * Check in on them on Mondays and we'll see what happens!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-23.es: * ¡Míralos los lunes y veremos qué pasa!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-24.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A monster floating between delicious smelling pies?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-24.es: * ¿Hmm? [wait:5]¿Un monstruo flotando entre tartas que huelen delicioso?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-25.english: * How novel![wait:5]\n* How bizarre![wait:5]\n* A fellow sicko,[wait:5] perhaps?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-26.english: * I have seen that different pie flavours have different effects on this one.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-26.es: * He visto que distintos sabores de tarta causan efectos diferentes en ese monstruo.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-27.english: * Try checking how it differs between Tuesday and Saturday...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-27.es: * Intenta ver cómo cambia entre el martes y el sábado...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-28.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A monster studying hard for an exam?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-28.es: * ¿Hmm? [wait:5]¿Un monstruo estudiando mucho para un examen?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-29.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* That's pretty juicy!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-30.english: * How about you check again tomorrow to see how the exam went?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-30.es: * ¿Qué tal mirar de nuevo mañana para ver cómo fue el examen?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-31.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A strange smell coming out of a dorm room?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-31.es: * ¿Hmm? [wait:5]¿Un olor extraño saliendo de una residencia?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-33.english: * Don't worry,[wait:5] I think the student is doing fine enough!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-33.es: * No te preocupes,[wait:5] ¡creo que el estudiante está bastante bien!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-34.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] A child playing games in secret in their bed?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-34.es: * ¿Hmm?[wait:5] ¿Una criatura jugando a escondidas en la cama?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-36.english: * What other things might charming children do...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-36.es: * Qué otras cosas harán las criaturas encantadoras...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-37.english: * Try checking on mornings where they won't have school!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-37.es: * ¡Intenta mirar las mañanas en que no tengan clase!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-38.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] A pair of eyes,[wait:5] lurking in the dark?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-38.es: * ¿Hmm?[wait:5] ¿Un par de ojos,[wait:5] acechando en la oscuridad?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-39.english: * And you barked at them![wait:5]\n* How adorable!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-40.english: * Now,[wait:5] don't make that face,[wait:5] fellow sicko!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-40.es: * Ahora,[wait:5] no pongas esa cara,[wait:5] colega fisgón.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-41.english: * This is good.[wait:5] You've gained the respect of the pack.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-41.es: * Esto está bien.[wait:5] Te has ganado el respeto de la manada.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-42.english: * We will see how this develops in the future...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-42.es: * Veremos cómo se desarrolla esto en el futuro...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-44.english: * Come back with more intel,[wait:5] fellow sicko!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-2.english: * I tried to order something to eat from this store,[wait:5] but they won't sell it to me!
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-2.es: * Intenté pedir algo de comer en esta tienda,[wait:5] ¡pero no quieren vendérmelo!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-3.english: * And the owner really wants me to leave,[wait:5] he says I'm wasting his precious time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-3.es: * Y el dueño quiere que me vaya,[wait:5] dice que estoy desperdiciando su valioso tiempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-4.english: * Come on...[wait:5] I'm not that time-consuming,[wait:5] am I?

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-5.english: * My mother taught me to never waste time!
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-5.es: * ¡Mi madre me enseñó a no desperdiciar nunca el tiempo!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-6.english: * This is why I eat the whole clock and never leave any leftovers.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-6.es: * Por eso me como el reloj entero y nunca dejo sobras.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Hmm?[wait:5]\n* A Sundial flower?
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * ¿Hmm?[wait:5]\n* ¿Una flor Reloj de Sol?

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I'm afraid I just recently sold our last blooming Sundial flower.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Me temo que hace poco vendí nuestra última flor Reloj de Sol florecida.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * But do not despair,[wait:5] we always have seeds prepared so that no time is wasted.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Pero no desesperes,[wait:5] siempre tenemos semillas preparadas para no perder tiempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * If you want your own,[wait:5] we can give you a seed to grow and some tips on tending to it.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Si quieres una,[wait:5] podemos darte una semilla para cultivar y algunos consejos para cuidarla.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * But it seems as if your inventory is full.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Pero parece que tienes el inventario lleno.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * That's quite poor planning.\n[wait:5]* If you're to take care of a flower,[wait:5] you ought to be more mindful.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Eso es bastante mala planificación.\n[wait:5]* Si vas a cuidar una flor,[wait:5] deberías ser más previsor.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I have a pot in the back that I can send up to your apartment.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Tengo una maceta atrás que puedo enviar a tu apartamento.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Once you plant it,[wait:5] growing this flower will be simple,[wait:5] but will require dedication.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Una vez plantada,[wait:5] cultivar esta flor será sencillo,[wait:5] pero requerirá dedicación.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * You see, [wait:5]the Sundial Flower is quite fragile.[wait:5] If it goes a day without water,[wait:5] it will die.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Verás,[wait:5] la Flor Reloj de Sol es bastante frágil.[wait:5] Si pasa un día sin agua,[wait:5] morirá.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * So you must always water it every morning of every day without fail.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Así que debes regarla cada mañana, todos los días, sin falta.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * This exercise will test your punctuality and persistence.\n[wait:5]* But you seem responsible enough.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Este ejercicio pondrá a prueba tu puntualidad y constancia.\n[wait:5]* Pero pareces lo bastante responsable.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Now,[wait:5] let's not waste any more time.[wait:5]\n* Good luck.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Ahora,[wait:5] no perdamos más tiempo.[wait:5]\n* Buena suerte.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * (¡Recibiste la Semilla de Reloj de Sol!)

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Remember to water that seed every day.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Recuerda regar esa semilla todos los días.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Punctuality and scheduling,[wait:5] as always,[wait:5] is the key.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * La puntualidad y la planificación,[wait:5] como siempre,[wait:5] son la clave.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Ese niño está mostrando exactamente el tipo de conducta que condeno.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Bienvenido a Time Ltd.\n[wait:5]* Donde el tiempo y la puntualidad se valoran por encima de todo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * You are free to peruse our collection of timepieces,[wait:5] though do not tarry long.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Puedes examinar nuestra colección de relojes,[wait:5] pero no te demores.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Time is our most precious resource.[wait:5] Do not be fooled into thinking you have it in excess.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * El tiempo es nuestro recurso más preciado.[wait:5] No te engañes pensando que te sobra.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * It bemoans me to watch one with your youth treat it so carelessly.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Me apena ver a alguien tan joven tratarlo con tanto descuido.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Now,[wait:5] now.\n[wait:5]* Time is a-ticking.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Vamos,[wait:5] vamos.\n[wait:5]* El tiempo corre.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Don't spend your valuable time on idle chatter.[wait:5] I will not accept it.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * No gastes tu valioso tiempo en charla ociosa.[wait:5] No lo aceptaré.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Our business is the keeping of time,[wait:5] not its frivolous spending.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Nuestro negocio es llevar el tiempo,[wait:5] no gastarlo frívolamente.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Tick-Tock.\n[wait:5]* That's more time spent.\n[wait:5]* You may never earn it back.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.es: * Tic-Tac.\n[wait:5]* Más tiempo gastado.\n[wait:5]* Quizá nunca lo recuperes.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-1.english: * I'm a big customer here,[wait:5] the clocks they sell help me always run on time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-1.es: * Soy un gran cliente de aquí,[wait:5] los relojes que venden me ayudan a llegar siempre a tiempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-2.english: * You can't underestimate the power of a good schedule.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-2.es: * No hay que subestimar el poder de un buen horario.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-3.english: * All this place needs is to lay down some tracks.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-3.es: * A este lugar solo le falta poner unas vías.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-1.english: * This place also reminds me of rot and death.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-1.es: * Este lugar también me recuerda a podredumbre y muerte.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-2.english: * Either this square and its amenities was designed to remind us of our inevitable death...
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-2.es: * O esta plaza y sus servicios fueron diseñados para recordarnos nuestra muerte inevitable...

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-3.english: * Or I might have an unhealthy obsession.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-3.es: * O quizá tenga una obsesión poco saludable.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-4.english: * With rot and death.\n[wait:5]* My favourite things.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-4.es: * Con la podredumbre y la muerte.\n[wait:5]* Mis cosas favoritas.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-1.english: * Now now,[wait:5] there is no need to ring the bell.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-1.es: * Vamos,[wait:5] no hace falta tocar la campana.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-2.english: * You can talk to me right here to save us both the time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-2.es: * Puedes hablar conmigo aquí mismo y ahorrarnos tiempo a ambos.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-3.english: * We should have never wasted our time on installing that bell.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-3.es: * Nunca deberíamos haber perdido tiempo instalando esa campana.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-4.english: * Say what you have to say and stop spending your time needlessly.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-4.es: * Di lo que tengas que decir y deja de gastar tu tiempo sin necesidad.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-6.english: * I will not respond to such frivolous time wastage anymore.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-6.es: * No responderé más a semejante pérdida frívola de tiempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-7.english: * Feel free to continue wasting your precious time on useless dings.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-7.es: * Puedes seguir desperdiciando tu precioso tiempo con campanadas inútiles.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-001.english: * Now ain't this nice![wait:5] All up close and personal!\n[wait:5]* You see that UPGRADE option?[wait:5] Go ahead and take a peek.[wait:5]\n* I think you'll like what you see,[wait:5] chum!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-001.es: * ¡Vaya,[wait:5] qué agradable! ¡Bien de cerca!\n[wait:5]* ¿Ves esa opción MEJORAR?[wait:5] Échale un vistazo.[wait:5]\n* Creo que te gustará lo que verás,[wait:5] colega.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-002.english: * Listen here! This is a test for purchasing response talks!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-002.es: * ¡Escucha! ¡Esto es una prueba de los diálogos de respuesta al comprar!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-004.english:
* Listen,[wait:5] Listen![wait:5]
* You got a risin star business!
[wait:5]* You got big dreams,[wait:5] and I like that![wait:5]
* Love me some moxie!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-004.es:
* ¡Escucha,[wait:5] escucha![wait:5]
* ¡Tienes un negocio en ascenso!
[wait:5]* Tienes grandes sueños,[wait:5] ¡y eso me gusta![wait:5]
* ¡Me encantan esas agallas!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-005.english:
* [emote:impatient]But you're just a small fish in a marginally less small pond![wait:5]
* You gotta grow![wait:5]
* Expand![wait:5]
* Explore new avenues of profitability,[wait:5] ya feel me?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-005.es:
* [emote:impatient]¡Pero sigues siendo un pececito en un estanque apenas menos pequeño![wait:5]
* ¡Tienes que crecer![wait:5]
* ¡Expandirte![wait:5]
* Explorar nuevas vías de rentabilidad,[wait:5] ¿me sigues?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-006.english:
* [emote:laugh]That's why I'm here![wait:5]
* Your buddy Mawzz knows a thing
or two about making G!
[wait:5]* You want your establishment to get popular,[wait:5] ain't that right?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-006.es:
* [emote:laugh]¡Por eso estoy aquí![wait:5]
* Tu colega Mawzz sabe una cosa
o dos sobre ganar G.
[wait:5]* Quieres que tu local se vuelva popular,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-007.english: * [emote:laugh]Well,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] with me as your fin-ance man,[wait:5] you'll get so popular you'll even make it\nthrough da barrier and out onto the soiface!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-007.es: * [emote:laugh]Bueno,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] conmigo como tu experta en fin-anzas,[wait:5] ¡serás tan popular que hasta atravesarás\nla barrera y llegarás a la superfishie!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-008.english: * [emote:talk]With my help,[wait:5] even the humans will be goin crazy for your,[wait:5] ehh...[wait:5] What do ya call it...[wait:5]\n* Fin Cuisine?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-008.es: * [emote:talk]Con mi ayuda,[wait:5] hasta los humanos se volverán locos por tu,[wait:5] ehh...[wait:5] ¿Cómo lo llamas...[wait:5]\n* Fin Cuisine?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-009.english: * You heard the fuzzball,[wait:5] didn't ya?\n* \"The greatest restaurant the Underground has ever seen.\"
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-009.es: * Oíste a la bola de pelo,[wait:5] ¿no?\n* \"El mejor restaurante que el Subsuelo haya visto.\"

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-010.english: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Come on, chum,[wait:5] you're smart! [wait:5]If you wanna be the best,[wait:5] you gotta upgrade your facilities!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-010.es: * ¡GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Vamos, colega,[wait:5] ¡tienes cerebro! [wait:5]Si quieres ser el mejor,[wait:5] ¡tienes que mejorar tus instalaciones!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-011.english: * Sure,[wait:5] what you've got going on... [wait:5]It's got charm,[wait:5] or whatever.[wait:5]\n* But you've gotta start hustling if you really wanna be the BEST!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-011.es: * Claro,[wait:5] lo que tienes montado... [wait:5]Tiene encanto,[wait:5] o lo que sea.[wait:5]\n* ¡Pero tendrás que moverte si de verdad quieres ser EL MEJOR!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-012.english: * That's where I come in.[wait:5] You give \nme the G and the word,[wait:5] and I'll \nget it aaaall set up for yas.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-012.es: * Ahí entro yo.[wait:5] Tú me das \nlos G y la orden,[wait:5] y yo lo dejo \ntoooodo listo para ustedes.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-013.english: * More space,[wait:5] more customers,[wait:5] more money![wait:5] All from reinvesting in \nyour plucky lil' restaurant.[wait:5]\n* It's basic fin-ance,[wait:5] chum!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-013.es: * ¡Más espacio,[wait:5] más clientes,[wait:5] más dinero![wait:5] Todo por reinvertir en \ntu valiente restaurancito.[wait:5]\n* ¡Son fin-anzas básicas,[wait:5] colega!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-014.english: * Oh,[wait:5] and more stuff will be available as you move up in the ranks.[wait:5]\n* So make sure to check up on your buddy Mawzz whenever you've got the G to spare!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-014.es: * Ah,[wait:5] y habrá más cosas disponibles a medida que subas de rango.[wait:5]\n* ¡Así que visita a tu amiga Mawzz siempre que te sobren G!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-017.english: * You know,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] I respect what you've done with the place,[wait:5] really I do!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-017.es: * Sabes,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] respeto lo que has hecho con el lugar,[wait:5] ¡de verdad!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-018.english: * I mean,[wait:5] you had a pretty good foundation, [wait:5]but still![wait:5]\n* You've done a wondahful job.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-018.es: * Quiero decir,[wait:5] ya tenías una buena base,[wait:5] ¡pero aun así![wait:5]\n* Has hecho un trabajo maraaavilloso.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-019.english: * [wait:5]...Buuuuuut...[wait:5]\n* It could still be even better![wait:5]\n* Doesn't it feel a little empty right now?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-019.es: * [wait:5]...Peeeeeero...[wait:5]\n* ¡Todavía podría estar mejor![wait:5]\n* ¿No se siente un poco vacío ahora?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-020.english: * No,[wait:5] this place is utterly worthless for you.[wait:5]\n* Not that I know how you're here,[wait:5] too.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-020.es: * No,[wait:5] este lugar no sirve absolutamente para nada para ti.[wait:5]\n* Tampoco es que sepa cómo estás aquí.[wait:5]

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-021.english: * Actually,[wait:5] I don't think you're here at all.[wait:5]\n* I'm just talking to myself.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-021.es: * De hecho,[wait:5] creo que ni siquiera estás aquí.[wait:5]\n* Solo estoy hablando a solas.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-025.english: * I may not know what it is,[wait:5] but I know that it's important.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-025.es: * Puede que no sepa cuál es,[wait:5] pero sé que es importante.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-026.english: * Now that I think about it,[wait:5] I really know just about nothing about what I'm doing.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-026.es: * Ahora que lo pienso,[wait:5] en realidad casi no sé nada de lo que estoy haciendo.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-027.english: * So again I ask,[wait:5] why am I here?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-027.es: * Vuelvo a preguntar:[wait:5] ¿por qué estoy aquí?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-028.english: * I guess we'll just have to find out.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-032.english: * If I knew,[wait:5] I'd be a lot more confident.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-032.es: * Si lo supiera,[wait:5] tendría mucha más confianza.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-033.english: * I don't know why I'm not,[wait:5] though.[wait:5]\n* It must be a weird mental thing.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-033.es: * Aunque no sé por qué no la tengo.[wait:5]\n* Debe ser alguna cosa mental rara.[wait:5]

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-034.english: * Because I know I'm supposed to be here.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-034.es: * Porque sé que se supone que debo estar aquí.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-035.english: * And everything will go how it should.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-036.english: * I really have no input on this.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-038.english: * So yes,[wait:5] I don't know what's going to happen.[wait:5]\n* But it'll work.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-038.es: * Así que sí,[wait:5] no sé qué va a pasar.[wait:5]\n* Pero funcionará.

shop-mawzz_new-encounter_text-001.english: * Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] if it \nisn't the little chum!
shop-mawzz_new-encounter_text-001.es: * Vaya,[wait:5] vaya,[wait:5] si no \nes el pequeñín.

shop-mawzz_new-shop_text-001.english: * What do ya want,[wait:5] chum?[wait:5]\n* Ya got your eye on somethin'?
shop-mawzz_new-shop_text-001.es: * ¿Qué quieres,[wait:5] colega?[wait:5]\n* ¿Le echaste el ojo a algo?

shop-mawzz_new-shop_text-002.english: * Go on,[wait:5] chum![wait:5]\n* Take a peek at the upgrades.
shop-mawzz_new-shop_text-002.es: * ¡Adelante,[wait:5] colega![wait:5]\n* Echa un vistazo a las mejoras.

shop-mawzz_new-talk_deny_text-001.english: * I'm flattered,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] but you really wanna be payin' attention.[wait:5]\n* This stuff I'm tryna teach ya'll be vital to your business' success![wait:5]\n* You don't wanna miss out!
shop-mawzz_new-talk_deny_text-001.es: * Me halaga,[wait:5] colega,[wait:5] pero más vale que prestes atención.[wait:5]\n* ¡Lo que intento enseñarte será vital para el éxito de tu negocio![wait:5]\n* ¡No querrás perdértelo!

shop-mawzz_new-decor_deny_text-001.english: * Yes,[wait:5] yes,[wait:5] that too![wait:5]\n* Let's get to that some other time.[wait:5]\n* Working these out takes extra time![wait:5] And time is money!
shop-mawzz_new-decor_deny_text-001.es: * Sí,[wait:5] sí,[wait:5] ¡eso también![wait:5]\n* Lo veremos en otro momento.[wait:5]\n* ¡Prepararlo lleva tiempo extra![wait:5] ¡Y el tiempo es dinero!

shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-001.english: * This is where I'll put all the upgrades you can get.
shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-001.es: * Aquí pondré todas las mejoras que puedes conseguir.

shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-002.english: * Upgrades will give ya access to \nnew stuff![wait:5] New perks for your \nbusiness,[wait:5] new things you can do each day,[wait:5] make some things easier...
shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-002.es: * ¡Las mejoras te dan acceso a \ncosas nuevas![wait:5] Ventajas nuevas para tu \nnegocio,[wait:5] cosas nuevas cada día,[wait:5] facilidades...

shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-003.english: * Keep in mind,[wait:5] some of them might increase your costs each day,[wait:5] too.
shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-003.es: * Recuerda,[wait:5] algunas pueden aumentar tus costes diarios,[wait:5] también.

shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-004.english:

[wait:5]* An upgrade,[wait:5] on the house![wait:5]
* Lucky you.[wait:5]
* Go ahead and purchase it!
shop-mawzz_new-upgrades_deny_text-004.es:
