shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-030.english: * And this is our health food store!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-030.es: * ¡Y esta es nuestra tienda de comida saludable!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-031.english: * Regular grocery stores are just filled to the brim with junk food...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-031.es: * Los supermercados normales están llenos hasta arriba de comida basura...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-034.english: * Every monster deserves to get access to a healthy diet!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-034.es: * ¡Todo monstruo merece tener acceso a una dieta saludable!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-035.english: * So we had the splendid idea to make this store!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-035.es: * ¡Así que tuvimos la espléndida idea de crear esta tienda!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-036.english: * That may be true,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] but wherever one of us goes,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] we go together!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-036.es: * Puede ser cierto,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] pero adonde vaya uno de nosotros,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] ¡vamos juntos!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-037.english: * And I mean it literally![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]\n* Our roots have been conjoined \nsince birth.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-037.es: * ¡Y lo digo literalmente![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]\n* Nuestras raíces están unidas \ndesde que nacimos.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-038.english: * So,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] even if we wanted to,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] we don't really have a choice in the matter.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-038.es: * Así que,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] aunque quisiéramos,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] no tenemos mucha elección.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-039.english: * [wait:20]But that's no problem for us![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]\n* We're the bestest of friends!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-039.es: * [wait:20]¡Pero eso no es problema para nosotros![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]\n* ¡Somos los mejores amigos del mundo!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-040.english: * [talk:true]We're so in tune,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] that we can finish each other's-[talk:false]
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-040.es: * [talk:true]Estamos tan sincronizados,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] que terminamos las frases del otro-[talk:false]

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-042.english: *[talk:true] No,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] silly![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Our locally grown chilly chili and capshroom sandwiches!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-042.es: *[talk:true] ¡No,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] tontín![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] ¡Nuestros bocadillos de chilly chili y capshroom cultivados localmente!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-043.english: * The ingredients to which you can buy exclusively from us!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-043.es: * ¡Ingredientes que solo puedes comprar con nosotros!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-044.english: * They help cool off your mind,

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-045.english: * And wash out impurities from your skin,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] scales,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] or slime film!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-045.es: * ¡Y eliminan impurezas de la piel,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] escamas,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] o película de baba!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-049.english: [talk:false]*[wait:60] [talk:true]It's,[wait:5] um...[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Quite simple,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] actually.\n* We just make them using our-[talk:false]
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-049.es: [talk:false]*[wait:60] [talk:true]Es,[wait:5] eh...[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Bastante simple,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] en realidad.\n* Solo los hacemos usando nuestras-[talk:false]

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-053.english: * Well,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] cherished customer,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] all you need to know...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-053.es: * Bueno,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] estimado cliente,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] todo lo que necesitas saber...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-054.english: * Is that they are locally and ethically grown.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-054.es: * Es que se cultivan localmente y de forma ética.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-055.english: * Sis![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Don't spill the Snik & Snak family secrets![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-055.es: * ¡Hermana![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] ¡No reveles los secretos de la familia Snik & Snak![talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-057.english: [talk:false]*[wait:60][talk:true] Our parents didn't care enough to be creative...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-057.es: [talk:false]*[wait:60][talk:true] A nuestros padres no les importó ser creativos...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-070.english: * Why are our names so similar?[wait:10]\n* Oh,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] that's a funny story!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-070.es: * ¿Por qué nuestros nombres se parecen?[wait:10]\n* Oh,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] ¡es una historia graciosa!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-072.english: * Our names were clearly a lovingly considerate gift.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-072.es: * Nuestros nombres fueron claramente un regalo pensado con cariño.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-073.english: * Like a cute pair of matching sweaters!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-073.es: * ¡Como un bonito par de jerséis a juego!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-074.english: * A sign that we can count on each other,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] no matter what!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-074.es: * ¡Una señal de que podemos contar el uno con el otro,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] pase lo que pase!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-075.english: * That's only a guess,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] of course.[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-076.english: * It's not like we ever got a chance to ask about it.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-076.es: * Tampoco es que hayamos tenido ocasión de preguntarlo.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-078.english: * It's always been us two against the world,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] hasn't it,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Snik?
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-078.es: * Siempre hemos sido nosotros dos contra el mundo,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] ¿verdad,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Snik?

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-081.english: * Have you tried our newest batch of electric carrots?
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-081.es: * ¿Has probado nuestro lote más reciente de zanahorias eléctricas?

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-082.english: * They're sure to put a pep in your step with no added sugars or caffeine!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-082.es: * ¡Te pondrán energía en el paso sin azúcares añadidos ni cafeína!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-096.es: * [talk:true]Bueno,[talk:false][wait:25][talk:true] algunas personas...\n[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]* ...[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]\n* ...Sí,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] no,[wait:5] estoy de acuerdo,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] Snak.[talk:false]

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-097.english: * A restaurant? You're making a restaurant with your buddy?
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-097.es: * ¿Un restaurante? ¿Estás montando un restaurante con tu amigo?

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-099.english: * Two friends coming together to make their shared dreams come true...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-099.es: * Dos amigos uniéndose para hacer realidad sus sueños compartidos...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-100.english: * What a touching story,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] I could cry!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-101.english: * There's nothing quite like two people supporting each other...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-101.es: * No hay nada como dos personas apoyándose mutuamente...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-103.english: * Just make sure the food you're serving is up to the health code.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-103.es: * Solo asegúrate de que la comida que sirves cumpla las normas sanitarias.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-104.english: * If I find out you're serving unhealthy food out there...
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-104.es: * Si descubro que estás sirviendo comida poco saludable por ahí...

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-107.english: * You can buy our healthy ingredients and use those when you COOK!
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-107.es: * ¡Puedes comprar nuestros ingredientes saludables y usarlos al COCINAr!

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-108.english: * They'll make your food so much healthier.
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-108.es: * Harán que tu comida sea mucho más saludable.

shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-109.english: * And I'm sure your customers will adore it.[talk:false][wait:10]\n* [talk:true]Don't you agree,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] sis?
shop-sniksnak_new-startDialogue-109.es: * Y seguro que a tus clientes les encantará.[talk:false][wait:10]\n* [talk:true]¿No estás de acuerdo,[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true] hermana?

shop-sniksnak_new-standaloneText-006.english: * (Who goes to a store to sell stuff?)[talk:false]
shop-sniksnak_new-standaloneText-006.es: * (¿Quién va a una tienda a vender cosas?)[talk:false]

shop-sniksnak_new-standaloneText-009.english: * [talk:true]We appreciate the offer but we grow all of our own food.\n[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]Right,[wait:5] sis?[talk:false]
shop-sniksnak_new-standaloneText-009.es: * [talk:true]Agradecemos la oferta, pero cultivamos toda nuestra comida.\n[talk:false][wait:5][talk:true]¿Verdad,[wait:5] hermana?[talk:false]

shop-sniksnak_new-buy_text-001.english: Ⓥ\"[keeper:2]* [talk:true]Thanks for the patronage![talk:false][emote:idle]\"--this seems to make snik talk for some reason??
shop-sniksnak_new-buy_text-001.es: Ⓥ\"[keeper:2]* [talk:true]¡Gracias por la compra![talk:false][emote:idle]\"--esto parece hacer que snik hable por alguna razón??"

battlecutscene-democustomers-text-froggi.english: * It doesn't turn into a prince,[wait:5] but more flies were drawn in by the romantic tension!

battlecutscene-democustomers-text-mimiUn.english: * You got an idea for the recipe!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Now that's just the cherry on top!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: ¡Eso sí que es la guinda del pastel!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: I want to be a big dragon that breathes fire!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: ¡Quiero ser un gran dragón que escupe fuego!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: If only there was something that would let me breathe fire...
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: Si tan solo hubiera algo que me dejara escupir fuego...

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: ¡N-No...![wait:5] ¡No sabes lo mal que me veo!

It looks delicious!\n[wait:5]I feel so much more confident!

Hmm,[wait:5] creo que las albóndigas\nsuenan bien...

Grillby'll be able to tell you about a customer's preferences!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Specific requirements,[wait:5] ingredients they like,[wait:5] you name it!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: Requisitos específicos,[wait:5] ingredientes que les gustan,[wait:5] ¡lo que sea!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Even stuff you might not find out otherwise.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: All in exchange for just a few seconds of your time.
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: Todo a cambio de solo unos segundos de tu tiempo.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: That's the perfect use for his skills!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: So he'll only be able to help once a day.
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.es: Así que solo podrá ayudar una vez al día.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-4.english: * You get plenty of extra time to compensate.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-6.english: * Is that they've got very particular taste,[wait:3] see?
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-6.es: * Es que tienen gustos muy específicos,[wait:3] ¿entiendes?

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-7.english: * You can't just turn your brain off and [color:green]COOK!
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-7.es: * ¡No puedes apagar el cerebro y simplemente [color:green]COCINAr!

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-8.english: * You need to figure out what they want and how they want it,

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-11.english: * And that's just a waste of time!

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.english: * He seems to mull it over.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.es: * Al final no pudiste soportar la presión,\n[wait:5]¿eh?

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Hey![wait:5] Worker![wait:5]\nIt's my kid's birthday and he wants pancakes!
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.es: ¡Oye![wait:5] ¡Empleado![wait:5]\n¡Es el cumpleaños de mi hijo y quiere panqueques!

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Now,[wait:5] quick,[wait:5] ask Grillby for help![wait:5]\nYou can do it from the SERVE menu!
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.es: Ahora,[wait:5] rápido,[wait:5] ¡pídele ayuda a Grillby![wait:5]\n¡Puedes hacerlo desde el menú SERVIR!

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Why would I tell you,[wait:5] burger flipper?
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.es: ¿Por qué iba a decírtelo,[wait:5] volteador de hamburguesas?

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: (Try asking Grillby from the SERVE menu!)

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: The customer should always feel welcome at the Eclipse.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.es: * Luna te dio un puñado de INGREDIENTES.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.english: * They were added to your INGREDIENTs hole.
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.es: * Se añadieron a tu agujero de INGREDIENTES.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: I forgot to mention this yesterday!

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es: A veces,[wait:5] la preferencia que\nrevelas al\nACTUAR...

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Won't be for how\nthey want the food COOKed,
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es: No será sobre cómo\nquieren la comida COCINAda,

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: But rather what\nsort of INGREDIENTs\nthey want!
Adding in an INGREDIENT the customer likes...
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es: Añadir un INGREDIENTE que le guste al cliente...

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english:
Will give a big
bonus to the GOLD
and PRESTIGE they
give us!
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es:
¡Dará una gran
bonificación al ORO
y PRESTIGIO que
nos den!

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Here,[wait:5] I have a few that have been\nlying around for a while.
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es: Aquí,[wait:5] tengo algunos que llevan\ntiempo guardados.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Why don't you try using them and see what happens?
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.es: ¿Por qué no pruebas a usarlos y ves qué pasa?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask_ear.english: * You ask how Luna wants\ntheir pancakes.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask-1.english: * You ask how Luna wants\ntheir pancakes.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-complim.english: * You tell Luna their acting was pretty good.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-complim.es: * Le dices a Luna que su actuación estuvo muy bien.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wave:2]Woah,[wait:10] [wave:0]your SOUL\nlooks real neat!
Green's my favorite color!
Oops,[wait:5] sorry,[wait:5] I got distracted.
Anyway,[wait:5] I presume\nyou know how to COOK,[wait:3] so I'll skip over those basics.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: En fin,[wait:5] supongo\nque sabes COCINAR,[wait:3] así que me saltaré lo básico.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The most important thing is this:[wait:10] the TIME LIMIT.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Lo más importante es esto:[wait:10] el LÍMITE DE TIEMPO.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You need to serve\ncustomers before they get impatient and leave.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Tienes que servir\na los clientes antes de que se impacienten y se vayan.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If they don't get their food in a\ntimely manner,[wait:5]\nthey'll ditch.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Si no reciben la comida a\ntiempo,[wait:5]\nse irán.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No food,[wait:5] no money,[wait:5]\nno nothing.
But,[wait:3] the faster we\nget them their food...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero,[wait:3] cuanto más rápido\nles sirvamos la comida...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The more GOLD and PRESTIGE we'll get!
Of course, that doesn't mean you should rush out mediocre food!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Claro, eso no significa que debas sacar comida mediocre a toda prisa!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Our customers should leave our restaurant as happy as possible.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Nuestros clientes deben salir del restaurante lo más felices posible.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I want our food to touch everybody's soul!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Quiero que nuestra comida llegue al alma de todo el mundo!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Metaphorically,[wait:5] anyway.
Let's practice,[wait:3]\nshall we?
I'll act as the customer.
Ahem.
Hello,[wait:3] I would like some pancakes,[wait:3]\nplease.
And make it snappy!
[wave:1](Sorry for the harshness,[wait:5] I'm just trying to be authentic.)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: [wave:1](Perdón por la brusquedad,[wait:5] solo intento que parezca real.)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Alright,[wait:5] now you can start COOKing.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Bien,[wait:5] ahora puedes empezar a COCINAR.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Good job,[wait:5] Sunny!
You did pretty well.
However,[wait:5] if you\nreally want to go above and beyond...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero,[wait:5] si de verdad\nquieres ir más allá...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english:
You'll need to
cater to the
customer's taste
more directly.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es:
Tendrás que
adaptarte al
gusto del cliente
de forma más directa.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: While customers\nwill give you\ntheir order...
The way you prepare it affects how much they enjoy it!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡La forma en que lo prepares influye en cuánto les gustará!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Some customers\nprefer their food\ndone a certain way,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Algunos clientes\nprefieren la comida\nhecha de cierta forma,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: And won't mention it in their order.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Y no lo mencionarán en su pedido.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If you really want\nto impress them...
You'll need to ACT\nto have them reveal their preferences.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Tendrás que ACTUAR\npara que revelen sus preferencias.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Of course,[wait:5] this\ncomes with a minor time loss.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Claro,[wait:5] esto\nte cuesta un poco de tiempo.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But,[wait:5] with the new information,[wait:2] you can make up for it...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero,[wait:5] con la nueva información,[wait:2] puedes compensarlo...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: With the higher GOLD and PRESTIGE we get by making them happy!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Con más ORO y PRESTIGIO por hacerlos felices!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Isn't it nice to\nmake people happy?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¿No es bonito\nhacer feliz a la gente?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Anyway,[wait:2] go ahead,[wait:5]\ntry some ACTs to get me to reveal my preferences!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: En fin,[wait:2] adelante,[wait:5]\n¡prueba algunas ACCIONES para que revele mis preferencias!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] and don't worry about time counting down during ACTs.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Ah,[wait:5] y no te preocupes por el tiempo durante las ACCIONES.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Time is deducted automatically after using an ACT.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: El tiempo se descuenta automáticamente después de usar una ACCIÓN.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: O-Oh!
Burnt on one side...,
And completely raw on the other!
Why did you do that?
(Did they know my secret preference...?)
U-umm,[wait:5] well...,
How about you give it another shot?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¿Qué tal si lo intentas otra vez?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: O-Oh!
Sunny,[wait:5] these look delicious,[wait:5] but
you need to ASK how I want my pancakes prepared.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: tienes que PREGUNTAR cómo quiero mis tortitas.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (I didn't tell them my preference yet,[wait:5] did I?)
Alright,[wait:5] looks like you got it!
You seem ready to start this job for real!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Parece que ya puedes empezar a trabajar de verdad!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Well done,[wait:2] Sunny!
Sorry for talking\nyour ear off like that...
But I appreciate the attentiveness!
The last thing you have to do is SERVE me my pancakes!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Lo último que tienes que hacer es SERVIRME las tortitas!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I have a good\nfeeling about this!
Oh,[wait:5] yes.
That was something\nI was going to bring up later.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Eso era algo\nque iba a explicar después.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: For now,[wait:5] just make\nthem like normal.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Por ahora,[wait:5] hazlas\nde la forma normal.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I like it when my pancakes are burnt on one side...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Me gustan las tortitas quemadas por un lado...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wait:5]and raw on the other.
It's my signature style!
People think it's weird,[wait:5] but they don't know what they're missing.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: La gente cree que es raro,[wait:5] pero no sabe lo que se pierde.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (Now,[wait:5] since you know how to do it better,)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: (Ahora,[wait:5] ya que sabes cómo hacerlo mejor,)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (Why don't you RETRY the COOKing step?)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: (¿Por qué no REPITES el paso de COCINAR?)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Huh? [wait:5]Really?
Oh,[wait:5] thank you,[wait:5]\nSunny!
I've had to interact with countless angry customers when I-
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: He tenido que lidiar con incontables clientes furiosos cuando yo-

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: .[wait:8].[wait:8].[wait:8]Wait.
Come on,[wait:5] Sunny,[wait:5]\nlet's stay focused\non COOKing!
No distractions!
Hmm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5] not quite.
These are great pancakes,[wait:5] don't get me wrong!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Estas tortitas están geniales,[wait:5] ¡no me malinterpretes!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But they don't match my preference.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero no coinciden con mi preferencia.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If this was real,[wait:5] you would have lost out on GOLD and PRESTIGE.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Si esto fuera de verdad,[wait:5] habrías perdido ORO y PRESTIGIO.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: It's okay.[wait:10] You can always ASK me for my preference again!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: No pasa nada.[wait:10] ¡Siempre puedes PREGUNTARME mi preferencia otra vez!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Umm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:10] These are normal pancakes\nagain.
Wait,[wait:10] you don't\nthink my pancake\nstyle is weird,[wait:3] too,[wait:5] do you?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Espera,[wait:10] no\ncreerás que mi estilo\nde tortitas es raro,[wait:3] también,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Well-[wait:10] some customers may have weirder preferences,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Bueno-[wait:10] algunos clientes pueden tener preferencias todavía más raras,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But how can we say we're the Greatest Restaurant in the Underground.[wait:2].[wait:2].
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero ¿cómo podemos decir que somos el Mejor Restaurante del Subsuelo.[wait:2].[wait:2].

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If we ignore\nsomeone's tastes\njust because they're different?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¿Si ignoramos\nel gusto de alguien\nsolo porque es diferente?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Go on.[wait:10]\nTry again.
[wait:10].[wait:10].[wait:10].
.[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]Well,[wait:10] it's alright,[wait:5] we don't have to get it perfect.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: .[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]Bueno,[wait:10] no pasa nada,[wait:5] no tiene que ser perfecto.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You get the idea!
Oh,[wait:3] uh[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].
These are completely undercooked!
Make sure you let\none side cook long enough before you\nflip the pancake.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Asegúrate de dejar\nun lado cocinar lo suficiente antes de\ndar vuelta la tortita.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Wow[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].
Yeah this is super burnt.
Some black smoke is okay...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Un poco de humo negro no pasa nada...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But it usually means you're overcooking that side.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Pero suele significar que cocinaste demasiado ese lado.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] have we already\ntaken that much time??
That's not good!
We can't be wasting\ntime like this,
Not if we want to be the greatest restaurant in the underground!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡No si queremos ser el mejor restaurante del Subsuelo!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Let's just start\nit for real.
No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] you should click the button that says Grillby!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] ¡pulsa el botón que dice Grillby!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: It's under the one you just pressed.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Está debajo del que acabas de pulsar.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] you should only SERVE after you've finished the order!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] ¡solo debes SERVIR después de terminar el pedido!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I mean...[wait:5] Unless you're just trying to end this...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: Quiero decir...[wait:5] A menos que solo quieras terminar esto...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Wait,[wait:5] is that it?
Do you just want to skip this?
Honestly,[wait:5] that's probably for the best!
More time to bring my dream to fruition,[wait:5] after all!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.es: ¡Al fin y al cabo,[wait:5] así tengo más tiempo para hacer realidad mi sueño!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Okay, try and SERVE!
I feel so sigma!
WHAT???

WHO SAID THAT??

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-donotcook-.english: * You try to think of what Mawzz would want to eat...[wait:5]\n* But you draw a blank.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-donotcook-.es: * Intentas pensar qué querría comer Mawzz...[wait:5]\n* Pero no se te ocurre nada.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-4.english: * You try to bribe Mawzz,[wait:5] but you don't seem to have enough money for his hunger.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-4.es: * Intentas sobornar a Mawzz,[wait:5] pero no parece que tengas suficiente dinero para su hambre.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Alright Chum,[wait:5] I'll cut the chit chat.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Vale, Chum,[wait:5] se acabó la charla.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: I ain't here for just a bite.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: No he venido solo a picar algo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: As surprising as it may be,[wait:5] I'm not exactly a gourmet.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Por sorprendente que parezca,[wait:5] no soy precisamente un gourmet.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: To me,[wait:5] food is just another fact of life...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Para mí,[wait:5] la comida es solo otro hecho de la vida...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: And like most others,[wait:5] it's one that you can make bank off of!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Y como casi todo,[wait:5] ¡se puede sacar dinero de ello!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: So how about we cut the middleman here?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¿Qué tal si nos saltamos al intermediario?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: That's right!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Eso es!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: My order for\ntoday is[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Mi pedido de\nhoy es[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: If you can COOK me up 1000 G,[wait:5] I'll be satisfied!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Si me COCINAS 1000 G,[wait:5] quedaré satisfecho!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Otherwise...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: De lo contrario...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Well,[wait:5] on the topic of G...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Bueno,[wait:5] ya que hablamos de G...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Let's talk business.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Hablemos de negocios.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: This whole timer thing you've had going on?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¿Todo ese asunto del cronómetro que llevaban usando?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: I think it's missing a little bit of nuance...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Creo que le falta un poco de matiz...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Yeowch,[wait:5] chum![wait:10] You seem \nto be in some financial straits!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Ay,[wait:5] chum![wait:10] ¡Parece \nque las finanzas te aprietan!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Here,[wait:5] let me be generous so\nwe can have some more fun...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: Toma,[wait:5] seré generoso para\nque podamos divertirnos más...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Don't cha' know chum?[wait:20]\nTime is money!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¿No lo sabes, chum?[wait:20]\n¡El tiempo es dinero!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: And if you don't act fast,[wait:5] you'll run out of both!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Y si no actúas rápido,[wait:5] te quedarás sin ambos!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: So chop chop,[wait:5] chum!!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Así que deprisa,[wait:5] chum!!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Time to make me some money!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.es: ¡Hora de hacerme dinero!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: You're looking to\nsell these to get\nsome extra time!
Looks like you're in some fin-[wait:5]ancial straits,[wait:5] hehehe.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.es: Parece que estás en un apuro finan-[wait:5]ciero,[wait:5] jejeje.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: Say,[wait:5] if you've got any assets,[wait:5] items,[wait:5] you could part with...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.es: Oye,[wait:5] si tienes algún activo,[wait:5] objeto,[wait:5] del que puedas desprenderte...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: I might be willing to throw you a life preserver.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.es: Puede que esté dispuesto a lanzarte un salvavidas.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.english: This is a generous [wait:10]gift[wait:10] for your pal Mawzz!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.es: ¡Esto es un [wait:10]regalo[wait:10] generoso para tu amigo Mawzz!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.english: Well allow me to give you a little[wait:10] gift[wait:10] back.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.es: Pues deja que te devuelva un pequeño[wait:10] regalo[wait:10].

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know,[wait:10]\nI've always wanted to play the big bad in one of those videos games,[wait:5] chum.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Sabes,[wait:10]\nsiempre quise hacer del gran villano en uno de esos videojuegos,[wait:5] chum.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: They always get the cooler sprites!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Siempre tienen los sprites más geniales!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: And kickass boss music to boot!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Y encima tienen música de jefe brutal!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know,[wait:5] if I HAD to choose a different job,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Sabes,[wait:5] si TUVIERA que elegir otro trabajo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I think I'd be a treasure hunter.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Creo que sería cazatesoros.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: That,[wait:5] or a Broadway actor.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Eso,[wait:5] o actor de Broadway.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Taxes are the biggest scam in all of history.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Los impuestos son la mayor estafa de toda la historia.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: One time,[wait:5] it took two weeks for them to fix the pothole near my house.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Una vez,[wait:5] tardaron dos semanas en arreglar el bache cerca de mi casa.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [shake:1]TWO WEEKS,[wait:5] CHUM!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: [shake:1]¡DOS SEMANAS,[wait:5] CHUM!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: So,[wait:5] when the tax collector came by,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Así que,[wait:5] cuando apareció el recaudador,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I used him to fill the pothole myself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Lo usé a él para tapar el bache!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You gotta be resourceful,[wait:5] chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Hay que saber apañárselas,[wait:5] chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Ugh.[wait:5] Fishing.\n[wait:5]What a loser activity!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Uf.[wait:5] Pescar.\n[wait:5]¡Qué actividad de perdedores!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: When I was a pup I mud wrestled the fish myself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Cuando era un cachorro, luchaba en el barro con los peces!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know how hard it is to learn how to surf down here,[wait:5] chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¿Sabes lo difícil que es aprender a surfear aquí abajo,[wait:5] chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: We don't get good waves in the underground,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: No tenemos buenas olas en el Subsuelo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You have to make them yourself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Tienes que hacer tus propias olas!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chum,[wait:5] an objective\nfact of life is that\nexplosions are cool.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Chum,[wait:5] un hecho\nobjetivo de la vida es que\nlas explosiones molan.

property damage" 
and "risks social
structural integrity"?

¿Y qué si eso "causa

estructural social"?

can't handle an

no merece

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [noskip]GWAHAHA![wait:25]
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: [noskip]¡GUAJAJA![wait:25]

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like you've got a soft spot for money making schemes,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Parece que te gustan los planes para hacer dinero,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Don'tcha,[wait:5] chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¿A que sí,[wait:5] chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Can't say I blame you for having favorites,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: No puedo culparte por tener favoritos,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But here's a generous word of advice for ya.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Pero aquí tienes un consejo generoso.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Diversify ya' investments...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Diversifica tus inversiones...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Or you'll be looking at diminishing returns!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡O acabarás viendo rendimientos decrecientes!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: What![wait:10]\nI said generous,[wait:5] not free!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Qué![wait:10]\n¡Dije generoso,[wait:5] no gratis!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] so it seems like the Chum's got a strategy for dis order.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Oh,[wait:5] parece que el Chum tiene una estrategia para este pedido.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Adaptable![wait:10]\nI like it!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Adaptable![wait:10]\n¡Me gusta!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But how far will that take you,[wait:5] I wonder?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Pero ¿hasta dónde te llevará eso,[wait:5] me pregunto?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But enough about you,[wait:5]\nI'm the customer,[wait:5] aren't I?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Pero basta de hablar de ti,[wait:5]\nyo soy el cliente,[wait:5] ¿no?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: And in the service industry,[wait:5] the customer is always right!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Y en el sector servicios,[wait:5] el cliente siempre tiene la razón!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: So that means you gotta listen to me,[wait:5] chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Así que tienes que escucharme,[wait:5] chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You might not believe it,[wait:3] but I'm a self made man!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Puede que no lo creas,[wait:3] ¡pero me hice a mí mismo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: A real rags to riches kinda guy!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡De la pobreza a la riqueza!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Course,[wait:5]\nthat's part of why I'm helping in the first place.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Claro,[wait:5]\nes parte de por qué estoy ayudando.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Gotta pay it forward,[wait:5] you know?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Hay que devolver el favor,[wait:5] ¿sabes?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Granted,[wait:5] I didn't need help to get where I am now.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Eso sí,[wait:5] no necesité ayuda para llegar hasta aquí.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But that doesn't mean Mawzz can't be philanthropic when he needs to!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Pero eso no significa que Mawzz no pueda ser filántropo cuando toca!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: (Not to mention the tax breaks)
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: (Sin mencionar las deducciones fiscales)

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But I'm getting ahead of myself,[wait:5] the point is,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Pero me estoy adelantando,[wait:5] la cuestión es,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english:
I got here by being
a savvy shark with
my investments and
assets!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es:
¡Llegué hasta aquí siendo
un tiburón astuto con
mis inversiones y
activos!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Take my company for example!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Mira mi empresa, por ejemplo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Anyone can see that the underground is making a one way stop to overpopulation station.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Cualquiera ve que el Subsuelo va en viaje de ida a la estación de la superpoblación.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But you know what\nI see?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¿Pero sabes qué\nveo yo?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Opportunity!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Oportunidad!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: With Reel Estate-
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Con Reel Estate-

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I help solve that problem and make a tidy profit while I'm at it!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Ayudo a resolver ese problema y de paso saco un buen beneficio!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I mean,[wait:5]\nit's a real win-win situation,[wait:3] I say!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Quiero decir,[wait:5]\n¡es una situación en la que todos ganan,[wait:3] digo yo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: A real winapalooza!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Una ganapalooza!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english:
And then I can
use that cash to
invest into projects
like this one.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es:
Y luego puedo
usar ese dinero para
invertir en proyectos
como este.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You might have even seen some of my investments before-
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Puede que hasta hayas visto alguna de mis inversiones-

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Depending on how traveled in the underground youse are.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Dependiendo de cuánto hayas viajado por el Subsuelo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Though,[wait:5] that's not to say I don't have some particular interest in this investment here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Pero,[wait:5] ¡eso no significa que no tenga un interés especial en esta inversión!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Trust me,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Créeme,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I really do think there's something here worth the while!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡De verdad creo que aquí hay algo que vale la pena!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Either way,[wait:5] I'm still waiting for the full course meal here.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: De cualquier modo,[wait:5] sigo esperando el menú completo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: if you want this restaurant to have a future,[wait:5] you're going to have to pick up the pace!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: si quieres que este restaurante tenga futuro,[wait:5] ¡tendrás que acelerar!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: So whataya waiting for,[wait:5] Chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¿Entonces qué esperas,[wait:5] Chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Your customer is hungry!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Tu cliente tiene hambre!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You gotta get me the amount of coin that'll make this shark grin gill to gill!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Tienes que darme suficiente pasta para hacer sonreír a este tiburón de branquia a branquia!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: The kind of coin that'll get this shark a second gold tooth!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡La suficiente pasta para que este tiburón se ponga un segundo diente de oro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] and before you ask,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Ah,[wait:5] y antes de que preguntes,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: YES,[wait:10] that is real gold.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: SÍ,[wait:10] es oro de verdad.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You didn't think Mawzz would cheap out on that,[wait:5] would you?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: No pensarías que Mawzz escatimaría en eso,[wait:5] ¿verdad?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] and the best part was,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Ah,[wait:5] y lo mejor fue,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Since the old tooth was lost on the [wait:10]'injury',
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Como el diente anterior se perdió en el [wait:10]'accidente',

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Healthcare paid for the surgery in full!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡El seguro médico pagó toda la cirugía!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Good times...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Buenos tiempos...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: That's your other Mawzz tip!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: ¡Ahí va otro consejo de Mawzz!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: If someone else can pay for it for you,[wait:10] let them!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Si otra persona puede pagarlo por ti,[wait:10] ¡déjala!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Consider that one a freebie,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Considera esta gratis,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Since I'm in a REAL good mood.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Porque estoy de MUY buen humor.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: More so when the big meal is so close...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Más aún con el gran banquete tan cerca...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: ...[wait:10] Huh?
You've uh,[wait:5] still got G,[wait:5] huh chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Tú, eh,[wait:5] aún tienes G,[wait:5] ¿verdad, chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You're a real savvy saver,[wait:5] didn't realize you were the type.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Ahorras de maravilla,[wait:5] no pensé que fueras de ese tipo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Alright,[wait:5] I've done enough yapping,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Vale,[wait:5] ya he hablado bastante,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I'm going to stare at you menacingly until this is done.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.es: Voy a mirarte amenazadoramente hasta que esto termine.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] well,[wait:10] you hit the goal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Vaya,[wait:5] vaya,[wait:5] vaya,[wait:10] ¡alcanzaste la meta!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: By cutting what I asked for by more than half.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Reduciendo lo que pedí en más de la mitad.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Look,[wait:5] I get it,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Mira,[wait:5] lo entiendo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chance time screws everyone over from time to time...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: La hora de la suerte fastidia a cualquiera de vez en cuando...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But your job is to make me a satisfied customer,[wait:5] no?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Pero tu trabajo es dejarme satisfecho como cliente,[wait:5] ¿no?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
If someone orders
a whole pizza,[wait:5]
and you only give
half of one,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Si alguien pide
una pizza entera,[wait:5]
y tú le das
solo la mitad,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I don't think they'd enjoy that sorta fishy business.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: No creo que les guste ese tipo de negocio turbio.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But tell you what,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Pero te diré algo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Since your pal Mawzz is so nice,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Como tu amigo Mawzz es tan bueno,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I'll get you another chance to make me satisfied here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Te daré otra oportunidad para dejarme satisfecho!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
I'm sure you can
figure out how
to get me
that G,[wait:5] right chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Seguro que
descubres cómo
conseguir
ese G,[wait:5] ¿verdad, chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chop chop,[wait:5] we don't have all day!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Deprisa,[wait:5] no tenemos todo el día!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well color me impressed, Chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Pues sí que me impresionaste, Chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
After you lost
the slots,[wait:5] I
really thought you
were done for!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Después de perder
en las tragaperras,[wait:5] de
verdad pensé que
estabas fuera!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Double more than I asked for?[wait:5]\nNo easy feat I tell ya.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¿Más del doble de lo que pedí?[wait:5]\nNada fácil, te lo digo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Not just double,[wait:5] but triple more than I asked?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¿No solo el doble,[wait:5] sino el triple de lo que pedí?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Youse a money making fiend!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Eres una máquina de hacer dinero!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Seriously,[wait:5] it's like you're trying to impress me or something,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: En serio,[wait:5] parece que intentas impresionarme,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Quadrupling what I asked!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Cuadruplicando lo que pedí!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You're really a chum after my own heart,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: De verdad eres un chum de los míos,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: It...[wait:10] almost makes me feel bad for what happens next.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Esto...[wait:10] casi me hace sentir mal por lo que viene ahora.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But you're clearly one for surpassing expectations,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Pero está claro que te gusta superar expectativas,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: so I'm sure you have this in the bag!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡así que seguro que esto está hecho!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well lookie here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Vaya, mira esto!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like the chum's the genuine article!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Parece que el chum va en serio!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Ya got to the goal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Alcanzaste la meta!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like you've impressed me enough that-[wait:15]
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Parece que me impresionaste lo suficiente para-[wait:15]

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [shake:1]WAIT!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: [shake:1]¡ESPERA!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
I just got some
pertinent information
from my ear bud
that's definitely in
my ear!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
¡Acabo de recibir
información pertinente
por mi auricular
que sin duda está
en mi oreja!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Sounds like the
economy is hitting
an inflationary
period,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Parece que la
economía está entrando
en un período de
inflación,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Alongside some
statewide
investments hitting
some snags,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Y algunas
inversiones
estatales han tenido
problemas,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Causing the value of G to plummet!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Haciendo que el valor de G se desplome!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
We gotta adjust
that goal to be
worth exactly what
it should be!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
¡Tenemos que ajustar
la meta para que
valga exactamente
lo que debe!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Oh WOW,[wait:10]
the economy is
NOT doing good
chum.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es:
Vaya,[wait:10]
la economía
NO va nada bien,
chum.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Hope you've got a rainy day fund,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: Espero que tengas un fondo para emergencias,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Because you're [wait:5]REALLY going to need it now!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.es: ¡Porque ahora la vas a [wait:5]NECESITAR DE VERDAD!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.english: I mean look at these beauties!
It's some of the most G I've seen in my life!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.es: ¡Es de las mayores cantidades de G que he visto en mi vida!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.english: You've made me a satisfied customer!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.english:
The restaurant must
not have been
doing as well as I
thought it was.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.es:
El restaurante
no debía ir
tan bien como
yo pensaba.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.english: Welp![wait:5] I suppose I HAD my faith,[wait:5] but...
Real sorry 'bout this one,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\nNothin' personal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.es: Lo siento por esta,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\n¡Nada personal!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: You're looking to\nsell these to get\nsome extra time!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Monster food is \nquite different \nfrom human food.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: La comida de monstruo es \nmuy diferente \nde la comida humana.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You might be used to cooking with physical\ningredients,
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Puede que estés acostumbrado a cocinar con\ningredientes físicos,

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But in the underground,[wait:5] \nyou must learn to \nCOOK with MAGIC.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Pero en el Subsuelo,[wait:5] \ndebes aprender a \nCOCINAR con MAGIA.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: To COOK with MAGIC ingredients,[wait:5] you need a conduit for your soul.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Para COCINAR con ingredientes MÁGICOS,[wait:5] necesitas un conducto para tu alma.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Something to channel your desires for what you are COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Algo que canalice tus deseos sobre lo que estás COCINANDO.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Here.[wait:5] \nTake this.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Toma.[wait:5] \nCoge esto.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Culinary tools are the best conduits for magical COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Los utensilios de cocina son los mejores conductos para COCINAR con magia.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Do not worry about the specifics of what you are making.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: No te preocupes por los detalles de lo que estás preparando.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: That conduit will serve you well,[wait:5] regardless.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ese conducto te servirá muy bien,[wait:5] sea lo que sea.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Convenient,[wait:5]\nis it not?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Conveniente,[wait:5]\n¿no crees?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now,[wait:5] let us start COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ahora,[wait:5] empecemos a COCINAR.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Wonderful start,\n[wait:5]my child.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Maravilloso comienzo,\n[wait:5]mi criatura.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now it is time \nto mix the ingredients.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ahora es hora \nde mezclar los ingredientes.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You must mix with conviction,[wait:5] but remember:
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Debes mezclar con convicción,[wait:5] pero recuerda:

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Be careful not to push too strongly or it may spill.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ten cuidado de no empujar demasiado fuerte o podría derramarse.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Well done.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Muy bien.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now,[wait:5] the final \nstep is simple.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ahora,[wait:5] el último \npaso es sencillo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You need only place it in \nthe oven.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Solo tienes que meterlo en \nel horno.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Perfect!\n[wait:5]The pie is complete.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¡Perfecto!\n[wait:5]La tarta está lista.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I'm glad I was able to teach you,[wait:5] my child.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Me alegra haber podido enseñarte,[wait:5] mi criatura.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: If you ever wish to COOK again,[wait:5] let me know.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Si alguna vez quieres COCINAR de nuevo,[wait:5] dímelo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I will help you in any way I can.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Te ayudaré en todo lo que pueda.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Talk?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿Hablar?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Err...[wait:5] I suppose if you would like to,[wait:5] we can talk about something.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Eh...[wait:5] Supongo que, si quieres,[wait:5] podemos hablar de algo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: What would you like to talk about?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿De qué te gustaría hablar?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: What is it,[wait:5] \nmy child?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿Qué ocurre,[wait:5] \nmi criatura?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: ...The weather?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ...¿El clima?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¡Ja ja!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Oh,[wait:5] you are so funny,[wait:5] my child!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¡Oh,[wait:5] qué gracia tienes,[wait:5] mi criatura!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You see,[wait:5] here in the Underground,[wait:5] we do not have\nweather,[wait:5] per se.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Verás,[wait:5] aquí en el Subsuelo,[wait:5] no tenemos\nclima,[wait:5] como tal.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Some areas experience something like rain or snow...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: En algunas zonas ocurre algo parecido a la lluvia o la nieve...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But this is simply the result of water seeping in from the surface.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Pero eso solo es resultado del agua que se filtra desde la superficie.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Quite interesting,[wait:5] is it not?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Bastante interesante,[wait:5] ¿no crees?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You want to know my favourite food?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿Quieres saber cuál es mi comida favorita?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmmm...[wait:5]\nIt is hard to say...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Hmmm...[wait:5]\nEs difícil decirlo...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I suppose I quite enjoy a nice carrot cake.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Supongo que me gusta bastante un buen pastel de zanahoria.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Though,[wait:5] I've always loved baking Butterscotch Pie.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Aunque,[wait:5] siempre me ha encantado hornear Tarta de Caramelo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: It feels...\n[wait:5]Fitting.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Se siente...\n[wait:5]Apropiado.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: H-Huh?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿E-Eh?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Heh...[wait:5] heh...[wait:5] \nHa ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Je...[wait:5] je...[wait:5] \n¡Ja ja ja!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: How bold.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Qué audacia.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I appreciate the compliment,
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Agradezco el cumplido,

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But perhaps you\nshould find someone closer to your age.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Pero quizá deberías\nbuscar a alguien más cercano a tu edad.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: With your kindness and charisma...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Con tu bondad y carisma...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I know you can find someone better than an old woman like me.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Sé que puedes encontrar a alguien mejor que una vieja como yo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Would you like to \nhear a joke?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¿Te gustaría \noír un chiste?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmm...[wait:5] What does the moon tell the sun to wake it up in the morning?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Hmm...[wait:5] ¿Qué le dice la luna al sol para despertarlo por la mañana?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: ...[wait:5]Rise and shine!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ...[wait:5]¡Arriba y a brillar!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Ha ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: ¡Ja ja ja!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I am glad you enjoy my jokes as much as I do.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Me alegra que disfrutes mis chistes tanto como yo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: It has been very long since I had anyone to share them with.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Hace muchísimo que no tenía a nadie con quien compartirlos.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmm...[wait:5] I'm afraid I can't think of another joke at the moment.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Hmm...[wait:5] Me temo que ahora mismo no se me ocurre otro chiste.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: My child,[wait:5] do\nnot be so hasty!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Mi criatura,[wait:5] ¡no\ntengas tanta prisa!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: We have not even started.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Ni siquiera hemos empezado.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Oh...[wait:5] Do you not\nwant to learn to COOK?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Oh...[wait:5] ¿No\nquieres aprender a COCINAR?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Or...[wait:5] perhaps you \nalready know.[wait:5]\nIs that it?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: O...[wait:5] quizá \nya sabes.[wait:5]\n¿Es eso?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I see...[wait:5]\nThen I suppose we can skip this.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.es: Entiendo...[wait:5]\nEntonces supongo que podemos saltarnos esto.

lightenemies-catamari-text-007.english: * The ball seems to have calmed down![wait:5]\n* No more evil balls will spawn.

lightenemies-catamari-text-008.english: * The room is covered in yarn.
lightenemies-catamari-text-008.es: * La sala está cubierta de lana.

lightenemies-catamari-text-010.english: * The ball is excited about your COOKing!
lightenemies-catamari-text-010.es: * ¡La bola está entusiasmada con tu COCINA!

lightenemies-catamari-text-011.english: * The cat purrs and rolls.[wait:5]\n* The ball likes it!
lightenemies-catamari-text-011.es: * El gato ronronea y rueda.[wait:5]\n* ¡A la bola le gusta!

lightenemies-catamari-text-012.english: * The little cat feels like the king of the cosmos.
lightenemies-catamari-text-012.es: * El gatito se siente como el rey del cosmos.

lightenemies-dino-dialogue-002.english: I need to eat vegetables to grow big and strong!
lightenemies-dino-dialogue-002.es: ¡Tengo que comer verduras para crecer grande y fuerte!

lightenemies-dino-dialogue-003.english: I can't wait to breathe fire!
lightenemies-dino-dialogue-003.es: ¡No veo la hora de escupir fuego!

lightenemies-dino-check-001.english: Salad.\n* This mild-mannered monster wishes he was a big dragon.
lightenemies-dino-check-001.es: Ensalada.\n* Este monstruo apacible desearía ser un gran dragón.

lightenemies-dino-dialogue_table-003.english: What is this despicable wretched body
lightenemies-dino-dialogue_table-003.es: Qué es este cuerpo despreciable y miserable

lightenemies-dino-dialogue_table-005.es: Eh, yo soy el tercer tipo

lightenemies-froggit-check-001.english: French Flies[wait:5]\n* Not to be confused with\nthe potato things.
lightenemies-froggit-check-001.es: Moscas Francesas[wait:5]\n* No confundir con\nlas papas.

lightenemies-froggit-check-002.english: Famously a glutton,[wait:5] wants as many as possible!
lightenemies-froggit-check-002.es: Famoso por glotón,[wait:5] ¡quiere tantas como pueda!

lightenemies-froggit-text-003.english: * The restaurant is filled\nwith the smell of mustard\nseed.
lightenemies-froggit-text-003.es: * El restaurante está lleno\ndel olor de semillas de\nmostaza.

lightenemies-froggit-text-004.english: * Froggit has a very refined \ntaste.[wait:40]\n* Only kidding.
lightenemies-froggit-text-004.es: * Froggit tiene un gusto muy\nrefinado.[wait:40]\n* Es broma.

lightenemies-grillby-check-001.english: But what does he want?[wait:10]\nTry to ask!

lightenemies-grillby-check-002.english: Burger\nIf you ever need a refresher,[wait:5] ASK again!
lightenemies-grillby-check-002.es: Hamburguesa\n¡Si necesitas recordarlo,[wait:5] PREGUNTA otra vez!

lightenemies-grillby-text-001.english: * Is it getting hot in here or is it just him?
lightenemies-grillby-text-001.es: * ¿Hace calor aquí o es cosa suya?

lightenemies-grillby-text-003.english: * Grillby's fire makes his glasses flash like an anime boy's.
lightenemies-grillby-text-003.es: * El fuego de Grillby hace brillar sus gafas como en un anime.

lightenemies-grillby-text-005.es: * Grillby observa tu COCINA con atención.

lightenemies-grillby-text-006.english: * This order is really heating up!!
lightenemies-grillby-text-006.es: * ¡¡Este pedido se está calentando de verdad!!

lightenemies-grillby-text-007.english: * You feel a little lightheaded from remembering the order.
lightenemies-grillby-text-007.es: * Te mareas un poco al recordar el pedido.

lightenemies-grillby-text-008.english: * Grillby straightens his back and tries not to sway on his heels.
lightenemies-grillby-text-008.es: * Grillby endereza la espalda e intenta no tambalearse.

lightenemies-grillby-text-009.english: * Mawzz looks on with a large smile.
lightenemies-grillby-text-009.es: * Mawzz observa con una gran sonrisa.

lightenemies-grillby-text-010.english: * Luna pumps their fists in the air and cheers you on.
lightenemies-grillby-text-010.es: * Luna alza los puños y te anima.

lightenemies-grillby-text-011.english: * Luna tries to backseat your COOKing,[wait:5] but Mawzz blocks them.
lightenemies-grillby-text-011.es: * Luna intenta dirigir tu COCINA desde fuera,[wait:5] pero Mawzz lo impide.

lightenemies-grillby-text-012.english: * You feel a bead of sweat form on your forehead.
lightenemies-grillby-text-012.es: * Una gota de sudor se forma en tu frente.

lightenemies-grillby-text-014.english: * Grillby is slightly less anxious.[wait:10]\nHe's still sweating,[wait:5] though.
lightenemies-grillby-text-014.es: * Grillby está un poco menos ansioso.[wait:10]\nAunque sigue sudando.[wait:5]

lightenemies-licket-dialogue-002.english: Ready to lick it all clean!

lightenemies-licket-check-001.english: Ice Cream[wait:5] \n* Let's hope it doesn't melt...
lightenemies-licket-check-001.es: Helado[wait:5] \n* Esperemos que no se derrita...

lightenemies-licket-text-002.es: * La lengua de Licket olfatea tu comida.

lightenemies-licket-text-003.english: * Licket's tongue is waving majestically in the non-existent wind.
lightenemies-licket-text-003.es: * La lengua de Licket ondea majestuosamente con el viento inexistente.

lightenemies-licket-text-004.english: * What dat tongue do?[wait:5]\n* Ice Cream.\nIt eats ice cream.

lightenemies-mawzz-check-001.english: Your most esteemed customer yet... But what does he want?
lightenemies-mawzz-check-001.es: Tu cliente más ilustre hasta ahora... ¿Pero qué quiere?

lightenemies-mawzz-check-002.english: 1000 G or BUST!\nCOOK whatever you can to make him some money!
lightenemies-mawzz-check-002.es: ¡1000 G O NADA!\n¡COCINA lo que puedas para hacerle dinero!

lightenemies-mawzz-text-003.english: * Mawzz smiles wider.[wait:5]\n* His golden tooth glimmers like a star.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-003.es: * Mawzz ensancha la sonrisa.[wait:5]\n* Su diente de oro brilla como una estrella.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-004.english: * Luna watches from the sidelines and shoots you 4 thumbs up.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-004.es: * Luna observa desde un lado y te hace 4 gestos de aprobación.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-005.english: * Mawzz checks his golden watch,[wait:5] taps his foot and smirks.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-005.es: * Mawzz mira su reloj de oro,[wait:5] golpea el pie y sonríe de lado.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-006.english: * Mawzz snaps his fingers to catch your attention.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-006.es: * Mawzz chasquea los dedos para llamar tu atención.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-007.english: * Mawzz looms over you.[wait:5]\n* Some drool drips from his mouth.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-007.es: * Mawzz se alza sobre ti.[wait:5]\n* Un poco de baba cae de su boca.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-008.english: * Mawzz fixes his tie and puffs out his chest proudly.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-008.es: * Mawzz se acomoda la corbata y saca pecho con orgullo.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-009.english: * Mawzz's suit strains against his heaving chest.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-009.es: * El traje de Mawzz se tensa contra su pecho agitado.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-010.english: * Mawzz is curious to see what you'll do next.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-010.es: * Mawzz siente curiosidad por ver qué harás después.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-011.english: * Mawzz flexes for no reason.[wait:5]\n* The non-existent ladies and gents swoon.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-011.es: * Mawzz flexiona sin motivo.[wait:5]\n* El público imaginario se desmaya.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-012.english: * Mawzz laughs boisterously.\n[wait:5]* The building rumbles.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-012.es: * Mawzz ríe estrepitosamente.\n[wait:5]* El edificio tiembla.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-013.english: * You're not swimming with the fishies,[wait:5] you're swimming with the shark!
lightenemies-mawzz-text-013.es: * No nadas con los pececitos,[wait:5] ¡nadas con el tiburón!

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-b.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Maybe I can make these into some \n'Organic percussion!'","Those hipster musicians are all about that stuff."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-b.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¡Quizá convierta esto en \n'percusión orgánica!'","A esos músicos hipsters les encanta ese rollo."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Are the tax collectors on your lawn,[wait:5] Chum?", "Trust me,[wait:5] these fruits will make them think twice."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¿Los recaudadores están en tu puerta,[wait:5] Chum?", "Créeme,[wait:5] estas frutas harán que se lo piensen dos veces."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Bleh, mushrooms?[wait:5] Whatta I look like chum,[wait:5] a second rate plumber?", "You'd have been better off giving me kelp!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Bleh, ¿setas?[wait:5] ¿Qué parezco, chum,[wait:5] un fontanero de segunda?", "¡Te habría ido mejor dándome algas!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-e.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Ever heard of the Potato Battery?", "You won't after the Mawzz Patented Carrot Batteries!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-e.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¿Conoces la Batería de Patata?", "¡Ya no, con las Baterías de Zanahoria Mawzz!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-a.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Now this is a battery fit for the Mawzzmobile!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-a.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¡Ahora esta sí es una batería digna del Mawzzmóvil!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"You know,[wait:5] I heard humans \nuse this stuff as a weapon.","Not sure how,[wait:5] but the \npower within must be valuable!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Sabes,[wait:5] oí que los humanos \\nusan esto como arma.","No sé cómo,[wait:5] ¡pero el \\npoder que guarda debe valer mucho!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Why do people...[wait:5] like this stuff?", "Whatever,[wait:5] it sells good on the market,[wait:5] that's all that matters."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¿Por qué a la gente...[wait:5] le gusta esto?", "Da igual,[wait:5] se vende bien en el mercado,[wait:5] es lo único que importa."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-k.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¡Me encantan los gatos![wait:5]\\n¡Se venden de maravilla!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-b.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Globos...[wait:5]\\n¡Perfectos para sacarle dinero a los niños!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-r.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Wait,[wait:5] CHUM![wait:5]", "There's something I gotta tell you about me before-"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-r.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"¡Espera,[wait:5] CHUM![wait:5]", "Hay algo sobre mí que tengo que contarte antes de-"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-s.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Consider the following.[wait:5]\nFire breathing shark.[wait:5] Enough said."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-s.es: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Considera lo siguiente.[wait:5]\\nTiburón escupiendo fuego.[wait:5] No hace falta decir más."}}

lightenemies-mimi-dialogue-004.english: What a breath of fresh air!

lightenemies-mimi-dialogue-005.english: Huh?[wait:5] Teeth?[wait:5] What do you mean?

lightenemies-mimi-check-001.english: Pie\n* She didn't specify anything further...

lightenemies-mimi-check-002.english: Key Lime Pie[wait:5]\n* It really was that simple.
lightenemies-mimi-check-002.es: Tarta de Lima[wait:5]\n* De verdad era así de sencillo.

lightenemies-mimi-text-001.english: * You consider complimenting Mimi's chest,[wait:5] but it might come off wrong...
lightenemies-mimi-text-001.es: * Piensas en elogiar el cofre de Mimi,[wait:5] pero podría sonar mal...

lightenemies-mimi-text-002.english: * Mimi shifts uncomfortably in her chest.
lightenemies-mimi-text-002.es: * Mimi se mueve incómoda dentro de su cofre.

lightenemies-mimi-text-003.es: * Un ojo asoma tímidamente por la cerradura.

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-006.english: * Pumpkid tells a story about a child who fell down a well.
